codex.quest.dim_end.dragon.text.2: The quest checks visiting the End and obtaining Dragon’s Breath, not a separate victory advancement. Finish the fight for safer onward travel. Afterwards, mark the exit and outer-island gateway; save the breath for potions and Eternal Tales’ Eden crystal.
codex.quest.dim_end.dragon.title: Ender Dragon
codex.quest.dim_end.elytra.text.0: Elytra hang in an item frame inside an End Ship, which sometimes accompanies an End City. Not every city has a ship, so scout from a distance first. Bring blocks, spare pearls, and Slow Falling for outer-island travel.
codex.quest.dim_end.elytra.text.1: Reach the ship, deal with the Shulker guarding the reward, and remove the Elytra from its frame. Confirm inventory detection. Collect other useful loot without overloading before securing your return route.
codex.quest.dim_end.elytra.text.2: Equip Elytra in the chest slot and test a short glide from a low platform. Prepare rockets without firework stars for propulsion and plan repairs and durability improvements. Test over an island; obtaining wings does not provide experience flying over the void.
codex.quest.dim_end.elytra.title: Elytra
codex.quest.dim_end.end_et.task.0: Read how to craft the crystal and activate an Eden frame
codex.quest.dim_end.end_et.text.0: Eternal Tales structures with Eden-brick frames appear on the outer End islands. Mark a discovered frame and its safe approach, but do not expect an ordinary Sunstone to activate it; the stone is an ingredient for the completed Eden crystal.
codex.quest.dim_end.end_et.text.1: Crafting the crystal requires Sorcery level six and an Interdimensional Creator. Its five inputs are a Silver Block, two separate Sunstones, Dragon’s Breath, and Monster Blindness. Sunstones come after Nyetet in Purgatorium, connecting the two expedition routes.
codex.quest.dim_end.end_et.text.2: Use the completed crystal inside a valid frame after preparing a Return Ticket and supplies. This manual mark means the explanation has been read and understood; entering Eden is not required here. Actual entry and onward tasks belong to the Eternal Tales map.
codex.quest.dim_end.end_et.title: Gates of the Gardens of Eden
codex.quest.dim_end.guide_box_manifest.t: After four shells register, craft a Shulker Box from two shells and a chest. Place it near portal storage and pack a dedicated expedition kit of building blocks, food, lighting, and replacement travel supplies.
Break and collect the box, move it elsewhere, and place it again. Confirm the contents remain accessible. Perform this short test at home before using your only box over the outer-island void.

Label its role and separate valuable loot from emergency supplies. The objective records the box item; inspecting its contents is your action. Refill used consumables immediately after each trip so the next expedition does not discover an empty box far from home.
codex.quest.dim_end.guide_breath_reserve: Collect Dragon’s Breath during the first fight rather than resummoning the boss for one bottle later. Make eight empty bottles and put some on the hotbar. Leave space for filled results without replacing healing supplies.

Wait for a purple cloud on the End’s ground. Approach its edge, use a bottle, and move away promptly, avoiding sustained contact. Repeat only when safe; gathering material should not distract from crystals and the dragon.

Store the filled reserve separately after returning. Empty bottles satisfy preparation only, while the main breath card checks the result. Extra bottles support lingering potions and the Gardens of Eden Crystal, which requires Dragon’s Breath as an ingredient.
codex.quest.dim_end.shulker.text.0: Shulker Shells make portable boxes and supply mod recipes. Find Shulkers on and inside End Cities. Bring weapons, free inventory slots, and fall protection; their projectiles lift you, and danger often arrives when levitation ends.
codex.quest.dim_end.shulker.text.1: Fight from cover and collect shells after each safe group. Avoid exposed bridge edges and control your height and landing route. This objective needs four shells together, so wait before turning the first pair into a box.
codex.quest.dim_end.shulker.text.2: After detection, combine two shells with a chest for portable storage. Its contents survive breaking the block, helping transport loot. Before returning, make sure valuables are inside and the box itself has been collected rather than left in the city.
codex.quest.dim_end.shulker.title: Shulkers
codex.quest.dim_end.stronghold.text.0: Craft Eyes of Ender from Ender Pearls and Blaze Powder made from rods. Prepare twelve for the objective plus extras for searching because thrown eyes sometimes break. Do not expect exactly twelve to survive the whole journey.
codex.quest.dim_end.stronghold.text.1: Use an eye on the surface, follow its flight, and retrieve surviving eyes. Recheck direction periodically. Once they lead downward, descend using a safe staircase rather than a vertical shaft and locate the stronghold portal room.
codex.quest.dim_end.stronghold.text.2: Secure the room against Silverfish and lava and set a supply chest nearby. Put the missing eyes into the frame only once you are ready to fight, not before. The book counts eyes in your inventory, not an open portal, so glance at the frame before jumping: the black surface inside has to be there.
codex.quest.dim_end.stronghold.title: Stronghold
codex.quest.dim_nether.ancient.text.0: Mine four Ancient Debris with a diamond or stronger pickaxe for a Netherite Ingot. The lower Nether around Y 15 is a useful search area, not a guaranteed vein. Tunnel carefully with lava control and an escape route.
codex.quest.dim_nether.ancient.text.1: Smelt the four debris into four Netherite Scrap and combine them with four Gold Ingots. The finished Netherite Ingot is the goal: while gold and scrap lie separately, there is nothing to count.
codex.quest.dim_nether.ancient.text.2: Upgrading diamond equipment also requires a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template found in bastions. An ingot cannot replace it. Choose a useful first upgrade; a netherite pickaxe, for example, enables magical mithril mining. Avoid spending the entire first reserve on arbitrary armour.
codex.quest.dim_nether.ancient.title: Netherite
codex.quest.dim_nether.blaze.text.0: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses and circle their monster spawners. Go after them with armour, a shield, food and, if you already have it, Fire Resistance. Wall off the approach to the spawner so you can step out of the line of fire without falling off a bridge.
codex.quest.dim_nether.blaze.text.1: Sixteen rods come from slain Blazes; keep them in one stack so the book counts the full amount. Separately craft an Empty Blaze Burner and show it to the book before filling it. Right-clicking a living Blaze with the empty burner moves it inside — that is how you get a populated burner.
codex.quest.dim_nether.blaze.text.2: A captured Blaze and a stock of rods are different goals; neither replaces the other. Leave the spawner standing after the first batch — it will be needed again. Rods go into brewing, Eyes of Ender and mod recipes, while the burner with a Blaze inside becomes a heat source for your machines at home.
codex.quest.dim_nether.blaze.title: Blazes
codex.quest.dim_nether.fortress.text.0: Find nether wart growing on Soul Sand near stairways inside Nether Fortresses. It supplies base potions and many magic recipes. Explore a fortress before obtaining Netherite if prepared with protection, Fire Resistance, and a secure route.
codex.quest.dim_nether.fortress.text.1: Collect sixteen wart and some Soul Sand, then establish a home patch. Nether wart grows on Soul Sand outside the Nether, eliminating repeated dangerous trips for every potion. Harvest mature plants and retain replanting stock.
codex.quest.dim_nether.fortress.text.2: A bastion is a different structure, with Piglins and its own loot; wart does not grow there. Here the book looks only at the harvest. Once it is ticked, lay in a brewing reserve and plan a bastion raid separately — for gold, ancient debris and smithing templates.
codex.quest.dim_nether.fortress.title: Fortress and Bastion
codex.quest.dim_nether.guide_portal_shel: The first blocks around a Nether portal turn a random arrival point into a return station. Bring a stack of Cobblestone, spare flint and steel, and food. Inspect both exits, especially those above lava or exposed ledges, before extending your route.

Build nonflammable shelter with a protected passage and edge barriers. Leave arrival space in front of the frame. Store some blocks and a relighting tool inside so a ghast shot cannot eliminate your return route.

The Cobblestone objective confirms material preparation; finish construction separately. Test travelling home and back with both sides accessible. Then extend toward the fortress and quartz deposits without leaving dangerous gaps beside the expedition base.
Soul Sand brings a nether wart patch home. Gather eight blocks and set aside a few mature wart from the fortress for planting. Give them a small plot that will not be trampled on the way to nearby machines.

Plant the wart on Soul Sand, wait for the final stage, harvest and sow again. Such a patch needs no water. Keep the planting stock apart from brewing ingredients so a big batch of potions does not accidentally eat the source.

Compare stock after two harvests: it should cover replanting and leave a surplus. The item objective does not automatically monitor growth. A working patch eliminates dangerous trips for every potion batch and supports further Fire Resistance brewing for Nether travel.
codex.quest.dim_nether.nether_et.task.0: Find the Clocktower, inspect its four locks, and record its coordinates
codex.quest.dim_nether.nether_et.text.0: The Piglins’ Clocktower is a separate Eternal Tales structure in the Nether. Look for its unusual clock and four locks during exploration. Prepare a protected portal route, food, and inventory space; first reach the tower and inspect its entrance.
codex.quest.dim_nether.nether_et.text.1: The manual objective requires finding the tower, not immediately opening every lock. Record coordinates, identify the four locked positions, and mark the return path before confirming. Reading about the structure does not count as visiting it.
codex.quest.dim_nether.nether_et.text.2: Further opening follows Eternal Tales guidance toward Hell Overseers in the Blazing Wastes and four keys. This continues the crown and ancient-artifact storyline. Do not waste unrelated keys or dismantle the building before understanding its mechanisms.
codex.quest.dim_nether.nether_et.title: Piglin Clocktower
codex.quest.dim_nether.portal.task.0: Enter the Nether through a portal
codex.quest.dim_nether.portal.text.0: Build an obsidian rectangle with a two-by-three interior and ignite it with flint and steel. Corners are optional, giving a ten-obsidian minimum. Leave spare supplies at home and carry nonflammable blocks, food, and a way to relight the portal.
codex.quest.dim_nether.portal.text.1: After crossing, inspect the platform, secure exposed edges, and shield the portal from ghasts. Record coordinates and the nearest safe route. Beds explode in the Nether, and ordinary water cannot reliably protect you from lava there.
codex.quest.dim_nether.portal.text.2: The objective records visiting the dimension. Test the return trip before exploring farther, then extend a protected route gradually. This makes repeated Blaze Rod and quartz expeditions possible even if a later trip costs your equipment.
codex.quest.dim_nether.portal.title: Portal
codex.quest.dim_nether.quartz.text.0: Mine Nether Quartz from pale veins in netherrack. Choose one near a protected passage, inspect the ground beneath it, and avoid mining directly above lava. An ordinary suitable pickaxe works, while Fortune increases quartz yield.
codex.quest.dim_nether.quartz.text.1: Gather sixty-four quartz in one stack and wait for the tick before turning it into building blocks or parts: the book counts quartz itself, not blocks made from it. The experience from mining will go towards enchanting and repairing gear.
codex.quest.dim_nether.quartz.text.2: Quartz supplies observers, comparators, and many mod recipes, so keep some in the shared workshop. Rose Quartz and digital-storage materials require their own processing steps. Mark remaining safe veins after the first trip to support repeat supply without exploring anew for every order.
codex.quest.dim_nether.quartz.title: Nether Quartz
codex.quest.dim_twilight.charms.text.0: Charms of Life and Keeping appear in Twilight Forest loot. Find one tier-one copy of each and let them register, then keep them available for dangerous expeditions. They are consumable protection rather than permanent upgrades unlocked by discovery.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.charms.text.1: A Charm of Life activates against a fatal threat and is consumed to help you survive. A Charm of Keeping operates on death and preserves only part of your equipment. Tier one does not retain the whole backpack, so do not carry your entire store over the void based on its name.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.charms.text.2: Higher tiers provide stronger protection and need additional copies. Keep reserves at home and check whether a charm remains after danger. Completing this card does not require deliberate death; collect both and understand which protects life and which protects possessions.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.charms.title: Charms
codex.quest.dim_twilight.cinders.text.0: The Lamp of Cinders lies in a troll-cave vault behind Giant Obsidian. Obtain the Giant Pickaxe on the cloud island first, then return beneath the Highlands and locate the protected cache. Bring lighting and inventory space, preserving your route through the caves.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.cinders.text.1: Mine the obstruction with the Giant Pickaxe, collect the lamp, and let it register. Travel to the thornlands blocking the Final Plateau and use the lamp to clear thorns gradually rather than rushing into hazardous growth.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.cinders.text.2: The installed mod explicitly states that progression beyond the plateau remains unfinished. There is no required invented final boss to complete this chain. Keep the lamp as a passage tool and finish exploration while retaining a safe route back to your portal.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.cinders.title: Lamp of Cinders
codex.quest.dim_twilight.giants.text.0: The Highlands open after Hydra, Ur-Ghast, and Snow Queen progression. If acid rain remains, inspect those personal advancements. Beneath the cloud islands, search troll caves for Uberous Soil and Magic Beans in local loot.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.giants.text.1: Let the soil and beans register, then plant beans on Uberous Soil below the clouds to grow a tall stalk. Prepare fall protection and a descent point before climbing; the narrow stalk should not be your only return plan.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.giants.text.2: Up top, defeat the pickaxe-wielding Giant and take the Giant Pickaxe. It digs in wide sweeps, so try it well away from your base. You need it for Giant Obsidian in the troll vaults: the cloud expedition prepares you for the Lamp of Cinders rather than ending the line.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.giants.title: Cloud Castle
codex.quest.dim_twilight.guide_115_kitch: Experiment 115 comes from the Dark Tower, but an individually eaten portion does not regenerate. Collect eight portions and redstone, then choose a safe permanent kitchen site. Let the guide detect the whole batch before placement.

Place the portions together into a complete eight-piece food block and apply redstone to enable regeneration. Eat part of the placed block and wait for portions to recover. Test it in place instead of immediately breaking the configured block.

The objective counts prepared food, while the block experiment proves renewability. If nothing regrows, recheck the original full block and redstone application. This kitchen is useful beside portal storage, but distant expeditions still need portable food supplies.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.guide_fire_swam: After Minoshroom, save the Meef Stroganoff: this dish is what lifts the Fire Swamp’s protection. Wait for the book to tick the meal, then eat it when your hunger bar allows. Kept in a chest, held in hand or swapped for the boss trophy — none of that counts: the swamp waits for the meal to be eaten.

Open Twilight Forest advancements and verify labyrinth progression before travelling to the Hydra. Prepare ordinary combat Fire Resistance and healing too; removing regional protection does not make the boss’s fire attacks harmless.

If the area’s special heat persists, recheck personal Lich progression and eating the meal. More armour cannot resolve the story gate. This preparation saves expensive potions and explains why Minoshroom victory alone may not yet open the route.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.guide_route_map: Craft the Magic Map from its focus and eight paper after the focus registers. Open it in the Twilight Forest and locate your portal relative to major structures. Record coordinates separately because a map marker does not replace an exact entrance location.

Find the Naga Courtyard first and the Lich Tower next. After the Lich, identify three routes: swamp labyrinth, dark-forest stronghold, and Alpha Yeti cave. Explore them in separately prepared trips, gradually meeting Highlands conditions.

Check actual access through advancements and regional protection. The map reveals destinations without disabling curses. Revisit the route after each boss to mark openings and supplies; this is more practical than crossing the entire world in one overloaded expedition.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.hydra.text.0: Enter the Fire Swamp after eating Meef Stroganoff and earning its progression advancement. Prepare Fire Resistance, strong weapons, healing, and movement space. If regional heat remains, revisit the meal requirement instead of spending potions to bypass protection.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.hydra.text.1: There are several heads, and the opening comes when a mouth gapes to attack. Strike the open mouth, knock back suitable explosive projectiles and stay out of the fire breath. A severed head does not end the fight — watch the overall health bar.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.hydra.text.2: Collect the trophy and four Fiery Blood in one stack, then put the materials into a Fiery Sword; once ticked, the blood can be spent. This victory closes one of the three branches before the Highlands — the other two run through the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.hydra.title: Hydra
The Knight Phantoms live in the stronghold beneath the Dark Forest. After the Lich, find the entrance and set a boss trophy you have won on the built-in pedestal — that is what lifts the barrier. The pedestal card appears later in the book, but the deed has to be done here.

Mark your route through the corridors and collect armour shards from local enemies. Fight the entire phantom group in its chamber, watching thrown weapons and changing formations. Defeating one member does not complete the group encounter.

Collect the trophy after final victory. Process stronghold shards into Knightmetal and accumulate four ingots. Knight progression enables the Dark Tower’s devices, so check both loot and your personal advancement before the next climb.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.lich.reward.0: Opens the labyrinth, swamp and dark forest
codex.quest.dim_twilight.lich.text.0: After the Naga, locate a tall Lich Tower and clear rooms on your way to the upper chamber. Bring a shield, strong weapon, and healing. If protection persists, check your personal Naga advancement before continuing.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.lich.text.1: During the first phase, reflect pearl-like magical projectiles into the real Lich to remove shields. Avoid exploding fire projectiles. Deal with summoned zombies, then attack directly after the shields are exhausted, tracking the boss’s teleports.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.lich.text.2: Collect the trophy and dropped scepter. This quest specifically requests the Zombie Scepter, which is not guaranteed; return to another tower if you receive a different one. Lich progression unlocks swamp, dark-forest, and snowy routes regardless of which scepter reward you obtained.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.lich.title: Lich
codex.quest.dim_twilight.minoshroom.text: Minoshroom waits on the lower level of a labyrinth in the normal Twilight Swamp. After the Lich, locate an entrance and prepare lighting, food, and junction markers. Maze walls are slow to mine, making passages preferable to random tunnelling.

Avoid Minoshroom’s charges and retaliate after attacks while keeping retreat space. Collect the trophy and Meef Stroganoff. Eat the meal: consumption removes Fire Swamp heat and opens the Hydra route; storing the trophy is insufficient.

The Mazebreaker Pickaxe belongs to a separate protected labyrinth vault, rather than guaranteed boss loot. Find the cache and inspect traps before opening it. Save the pick for later mazes; story progression need not wait for it after you have eaten the meal.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.naga.text.0: Find the Naga in an open stone courtyard with pillars, marked on the Magic Map. Prepare a shield, weapon, food, and movement space. Inspect the enclosure and do not rely on pillars as permanent cover because the boss destroys parts of the arena.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.naga.text.1: Keep your eyes on the head and the direction of the charge: step aside and strike as the body rushes past. Do not let yourself be pinned between the wall and the coils. When the Naga turns or freezes for a moment, that is the window to hit and to regain a good position.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.naga.text.2: Collect the trophy and at least four scales together after victory. Check Naga progression, which removes Lich Tower protection. Spend scales on gear after detection, but save the trophy for the later stronghold entrance pedestal.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.naga.title: Naga
codex.quest.dim_twilight.snow_queen.text: The snowy branch begins with the Alpha Yeti in its Snowy Forest cave. After the Lich, prepare protection, weapons, and healing, and avoid falling ice during combat. Collect fur; Alpha Yeti progression removes the Glacier’s protective cold.

The Snow Queen waits atop the Aurora Palace. Climb carefully with a return route, then strike during openings and avoid her attacks and icy beams. Protective ice elements are not the same as the vulnerable creature.

The card needs four Alpha Yeti Fur, the Queen’s trophy and an Arctic Chestplate. The arctic set is made from Arctic Fur; Alpha Yeti Fur will not do. When this branch meets the Hydra and the Ur-Ghast, check whether the Highlands have opened.
Enter the Twilight Forest through the flower-bordered water portal
In the Overworld, dig a shallow two-by-two pool, fill it with water, and surround it with soil bearing flowers or accepted plants. Throw a diamond into the water and step away from the lightning strike. A correct border changes the water into a portal.

Bring food, a shield, pickaxe, lighting, and building blocks. Mark the portal after crossing and inspect the nearest clearing, retaining an obvious return route. Permanent twilight does not make the forest safe; hostile creatures remain beneath trees and underground.

The objective records visiting the dimension. Establish a small cache, explore accessible surroundings, and make a Magic Map. If a region inflicts unusual damage or obscures vision, return to boss progression; a specific advancement usually removes that protection.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.tf_portal.title: Portal to the Twilight Forest
codex.quest.dim_twilight.tf_start.text.0: Find Liveroot in the Twilight Forest’s underground root systems. Collect four, then combine each with Raw Iron and a Gold Nugget to make Raw Ironwood Materials. Smelt them and accumulate four ingots for detection.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.tf_start.text.1: Craft a Magic Map Focus from a Raven Feather, Torchberries, and Glowstone Dust. Ravens provide feathers and underground growth provides berries. After the focus registers, surround it with eight paper to make a Magic Map; the focus alone cannot display terrain.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.tf_start.text.2: Open the map in the forest and inspect structure markers. It helps locate the Naga Courtyard, Lich Tower, and later destinations. Reserve roots and Ironwood for tools and relate landmarks to your home portal coordinates to avoid getting lost.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.tf_start.title: First Steps
codex.quest.dim_twilight.trophy.text.0: The Trophy Pedestal at the entrance to the Dark Forest stronghold is the mechanism that lifts the barrier. After Lich progression, place an accepted boss trophy on it — the Naga’s, for instance — and make sure the entrance has opened. This comes before the Knight Phantoms, even though the collection card itself appears later in the book.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.trophy.text.1: Explore the opened stronghold and collect the pedestal block once the structure allows it. The current objective needs the item to enter your inventory at least once. An ordinary trophy on a shelf cannot replace the special pedestal and its activation.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.trophy.text.2: Keep the pedestal in a labelled trophy hall at home. Do not assume decoration grants a permanent general combat bonus; its important confirmed role is removing stronghold protection. This card preserves the landmark block after its regional-progression job has been completed.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.trophy.title: Trophy Pedestal
codex.quest.dim_twilight.uncrafting.text: The Uncrafting Table appears in forest treasures, including some hollow hills and graveyards. Obtain it and place it separately from the ordinary crafting table. Uncrafting is enabled in the installed configuration, with restrictions on certain recipes and ingredients.

Run the first test on something cheap and simple: see which parts the table offers back and how much experience it asks for. Worn gear returns an incomplete set. Do not put your only precious relic on the table before you have studied what it shows.

The book checks that you own the table, not the luck of a disassembly. Do one clear operation and compare the result with what you expected. The table is good for recycling surplus loot, but it will not recover rare parts from every modded item or skip a production step.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.ur_ghast.text.0: The Ur-Ghast waits atop the Dark Tower after the Knight Phantoms. Explore floors, collect tower keys, and learn the Carminite devices on the way up. Bring ranged weapons, food, and fall protection for broken sections and exposed platforms.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.ur_ghast.text.1: Use the arena’s Ghast Traps. Kill small ghasts nearby to charge them, then provide redstone when the boss is above a suitable trap. Track its phases and retain paths between working platforms.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.ur_ghast.text.2: Collect the trophy and Carminite after victory, while Experiment 115 is found among tower loot. A single portion is not endless food; a regenerating block needs separate preparation. Completing the tower supplies another Highlands branch and useful controlled-building devices.
codex.quest.dim_twilight.ur_ghast.title: Ur-Ghast
Obtain a Stabilized Miniature Black Hole
Learn Order of the Universe through a Notice Board
The Arkemer legacy combines four late advancements: obtaining a Stabilized Miniature Black Hole, learning Order of the Universe, obtaining The First Prism and obtaining The Ultimate Two. It concludes Eternal Tales technology and research rather than requiring four random trophies at the same moment.

The starting point is the aetherium forge recipes: check whether you can reach their rare components. The stabilised miniature black hole is a summoning weapon, and only the required kill level lets you wield it. Obtaining it does not mean you are ready for the real black holes of this world.

Order of the Universe needs a separate action: apply its page to a Notice Board. The remaining marks concern obtaining their named items. Review all four objectives individually and finish the missing stage; the artifacts are not surrendered for the reward, and existing advancements remain recorded.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.arkemer.title: Arkemer Legacy
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.codex.text.0: The final seal of this chain opens after three trials: Eternal Darkness victories, the Arkemer legacy and the pack's seven peaks. Prepare one Nether Star. This is the actual item obtained from defeating the Wither, not another mod's decorative star fragment.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.codex.text.1: Move the star into your regular inventory and confirm that all three preceding cards are complete. Claiming consumes the star. A reward from an earlier quest also qualifies, so another fight is needed only if you no longer have a suitable item.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.codex.text.2: This mark completes Apotheosis but does not finish skipped quests on other maps. Check overall progress and choose a remaining project: a railway, settlement, expedition or a building of your own. The book preserves your journey, while the world's future arrangement remains your decision.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.codex.title: Codex Closed
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.darkness_unah: Defeat Unahzaal’s final phase in Eternal Darkness with Calamity Ring equipped and Humanity ≤−5000
Defeat Noxifer and collect his banner
Defeat Luciden and collect his banner

This summit requires three Eternal Tales victories: Noxifer, Luciden and Unahzaal's final phase under special conditions. Earlier chapters explain summoning and preparation; here the book combines their advancements into a final milestone without consuming trophies.

Noxifer requires Eternal Darkness and Humanity no higher than −10000; Luciden requires the same mode and a value no lower than +10000. Prepare these trials sequentially: one Humanity setting cannot suit both. Check the value and healing supplies on a separate arena before each summon.

Unahzaal's final phase is taken in Eternal Darkness, with the Calamity Ring worn and humanity no higher than −5000. Super Duper Darkness is not needed for it. Look for the special victory in the advancements specifically: a ring lying in the inventory and an ordinary boss kill will not grant it.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.guide_arkemer: Create an in-game archive recording location, preparation and finishing action for three Arkemer results

Late Eternal Tales recipes are easy to forget once every rare item sits in one chest. Make a small in-game archive of three completed results: the Stabilized Miniature Black Hole, The First Prism and learned Order of the Universe. Labelled locations and a book of your own notes are enough.

Write down where each stage took place, which components were hardest to get and what action closed the advancement. For the Order of the Universe, note applying the page to the notice board. Do not spend valuable artefacts on decoration: notes and clear labels are enough to retrace the path.

Once your notes can name the workshop, the preparation and the closing action for all three results, confirm by hand. No items to hand in and no facade to prettify. The archive will help after a long break from the game, or when another player looks over your base for the first time.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.guide_world_t: Visit three working locations from different branches along a labelled route and return to base

After the final seal, assemble a short tour of your own world. Choose three places showing different branches' results, such as a production workshop, a residential district and access to a distant dimension. This should connect real working locations, not list future promises.

Walk the route from base, check access to every place and leave clear labels at junctions. At production, identify where finished products arrive; in the residential district, find a used room; at the transition, verify a return route. Fix any small obstacle that actually prevents passage.

Complete the circuit by returning to base and confirm manually. The book neither measures distance nor judges building beauty, so the criteria are three functioning locations and one connected route. This tour reveals how separate milestones became a usable world for everyday life and further projects.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.task.1: Run an assembled excavator on a surveyed deposit and collect ore in storage
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.task.4: Build a level-five MineColonies Town Hall
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.text.0: Seven peaks join results from different paths: four Create factory gauges, a working Immersive Engineering excavator, eight antimatter pellets, sixteen 64k disks, a level-five Town Hall, the Lamp of Cinders and a visit to Ultimate World. The book consumes none of these resources here.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.text.1: Item objectives remember previously observed stock of each type. You may show gauges and then install them; disks can likewise return to the network after registration. You must hold sixteen disks together at least once, but all the different item types need not be present simultaneously.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.text.2: Confirm the excavator manually only after it extracts ore from a surveyed deposit into storage: there is no obtainable standalone finished-excavator item. The Town Hall uses its level-five construction advancement, and the final world uses a visit. If one mark is missing, return to that map and inspect its precise condition.
codex.quest.end_apotheosis.seven.title: Seven Peaks
codex.quest.end_marathon.antimatter64.te: Antimatter completes a long Mekanism chain: nuclear waste, polonium, the SPS and conversion of the resulting substance into pellets. The marathon needs 64 finished pellets. Owning an SPS casing or holding a little substance inside a machine does not complete the item objective.

Return to the nuclear-energy chapter and check stable polonium production and power delivery to the assembled SPS. Throughput depends on supplies and available energy, so there is no fixed promise such as one week. Service radioactive sections with suitable protection and planned waste storage.

Obtain one pellet and trace the full chain before accumulating a stack. Claiming consumes that stack. Retain a separate reserve for your own recipes, and if output stalls, check input substance, power and product extraction before expanding the reactor.
codex.quest.end_marathon.circuits256.tex: Mekanism ultimate control circuits finish the control-component upgrade chain. This delivery requires 256 finished circuits, four stacks. Atomic alloy and earlier circuit tiers are manufacturing inputs, but they do not replace the final item.

Work backward through the ultimate circuit's recipes and provide production for each intermediate tier. Pay particular attention to alloys: their processing needs different infusion materials. Make one circuit before the large order and verify that automation returns all results to accessible storage.

The four stacks for hand-in must sit in your ordinary inventory; they vanish with the reward. Fivefold ore processing helps with supply, but the recipe does not demand it. Scale up the section that truly holds the line back, and keep a few circuits for the next machines.
Nine crystals gather the far roads of Eternal Tales into one order: the Comets, Purgatory, Eden, Rayana, Karvat, Volcanech, the Amber Kingdom, Unahzaal and the Ultimate World. The crossing items themselves are needed, one of each kind; having visited the worlds is not enough — the crystals must be made.

Craft spare crystals using the Interdimensional Creator recipes you have already learned. Start with later crystals and inspect their inputs: some consume crystals from earlier worlds. Complete these nested recipes first, then restore a separate copy of each of the nine results for delivery.

Claiming removes all nine items. Preserve functioning portals, rebuilding materials and an independent route home beforehand. Return Tickets awarded here help with travel but do not replace a prepared transition network or make the surrendered crystals an unlimited reserve.
codex.quest.end_marathon.crystals9.title: Nine Worlds in a Pocket
codex.quest.end_marathon.guide_crystal_r: Complete a late Eternal Tales round trip after the crystal delivery while preserving access

Delivering nine crystals should not cut a traveller off from explored worlds. Choose one late route you actually use and check it after the delivery. Do not begin by destroying a portal: the objective is to preserve convenient travel, not to reacquire lost components.

Bring a means of return, leave a little food by the home entrance and note the crossing's coordinates. Take the chosen road, find the arrival point on the far side and make sure you know the way back. If you use a ticket, read its terms beforehand instead of trusting the name.

Return to base and confirm manually. The criterion is a completed outward and return trip after the production delivery without losing your only access. This inspection reveals an awkward exit or forgotten supplies before the next major expedition takes you far from familiar routes.
codex.quest.end_marathon.guide_mechanism: Test blank recirculation and separate finished-mechanism and secondary outputs on a trial batch

After a large mechanism run, check whether the line hides mistakes in a shared chest. Prepare a small separate batch of golden sheets and follow sequenced assembly without moving items between operations by hand. You do not need to repeat the production delivery for this check.

Set the output so that unfinished mechanisms go back for processing, finished ones into their own storage, and by-products do not clog the return. The filters of whatever funnels or sorters your line has will serve. Look at the item type: an intermediate part looks like a finished mechanism, but it is a different item.

Wait for the trial batch to finish and inspect all outputs. Finished-product storage should contain finished mechanisms, with no completed item circulating forever on the belt. Confirm separation manually; successful output count need not equal the number of initial sheets.
codex.quest.end_marathon.guide_processor: Complete a network order for eight new advanced processors through blank crafting and smelting

A processor line becomes useful network automation when an order survives the gap between blank crafting and smelting. Prepare recipes for both raw and finished advanced processors. The latter must be a processing pattern with the correct input and output, rather than an ordinary grid recipe.

Request eight finished processors with raw ingredients available but no finished-processor stock in accessible storage. Watch the crafting monitor: blanks should enter the furnace, smelt and return where the network recognizes the result. Temporarily separate existing finished stock without deleting it.

Confirm manually when the order finishes and eight newly made processors are available in the grid. If the monitor keeps waiting, inspect the furnace's actual output and the pattern's declared result. This tests the entire order path, so manually inserting eight finished items instead of processing does not qualify.
codex.quest.end_marathon.mech1024.text.0: Create's precision mechanisms are born in sequenced assembly, not on mechanical crafters. The marathon needs 1024 finished mechanisms. Unfinished parts and by-products do not count, so the line's output must separate them from the successful product.
codex.quest.end_marathon.mech1024.text.1: Inspect the sequenced assembly recipe: a golden sheet passes deployer operations using a cogwheel, large cogwheel and iron nugget across repeated cycles. Return incomplete parts for another cycle and route finished results to their own output. Follow one blank through the entire process before mass production.
codex.quest.end_marathon.mech1024.text.2: Accumulate sixteen stacks of finished mechanisms and move them into your regular inventory. Claiming consumes them, so keep a working reserve for repairs and other machines. If production stops, inspect each deployer's ingredients, the return route and available output space.
codex.quest.end_marathon.mech1024.title: A Thousand Mechanisms
Refined Storage advanced processors support higher storage parts and network equipment. This order requires 1,024 finished processors. A raw advanced processor is only an intermediate blank and does not replace the smelted result.

The blank combines processor binding, a diamond, silicon and redstone dust. It then needs smelting. Autocrafting therefore has two separate stages: crafting and furnace processing with the finished processor returned to the network. Test both with a small order and check the furnace's fuel or energy supply.

Once sixteen stacks have accumulated, move them into your regular inventory for delivery. Claiming consumes the full batch. Keep processors for maintaining your own network; the awarded disks and autocrafters expand it but cannot fix a missing recipe or blocked furnace output.
A batch of 4,096 steel ingots exceeds a regular inventory, so the book accepts the same amount in compact form: 455 Immersive Engineering steel blocks and one steel ingot from that mod. Nine ingots per block give 4,095; the final ingot completes the order.

Lean on the steelmaking you have already mastered and make sure iron and carbon arrive without interruption. There is no single right generator or furnace speed for a large batch. Finished steel is easier to pack into blocks as it comes out, setting aside a reserve for repairs and expanding production.

Check the resulting block's name: it must be the Immersive Engineering steel block. Move all 455 blocks and the ingot into your regular inventory together. Claiming consumes them; this quest does not perform partial deliveries from remote storage.
codex.quest.end_marathon.steel4096.title: Four Thousand Steel
codex.quest.end_monuments.bridge.text.0: A large railway starts with a track reserve, rather than a desperate attempt to stretch the last rail across a ravine. Prepare 2,048 ordinary Create train tracks: thirty-two stacks. Other rail variants, even those compatible with your trains, do not replace the specified item in this delivery.
codex.quest.end_monuments.bridge.text.1: Look up the track recipe in JEI and set up production of its base and metal parts. Give the order its own storage block, then choose the future route: to the colony, to the mine, or between them. The length of the line and the number of bridge piers are a matter of your taste.
codex.quest.end_monuments.bridge.text.2: The entire batch must be in your regular inventory when claiming and will be consumed. Clear enough space beforehand and keep construction supplies separate. An actual line with stations and a trial journey makes a useful follow-up project.
codex.quest.end_monuments.bridge.title: Bridge Across the World
codex.quest.end_monuments.cathedral.text: In the Domum Ornamentum architect's cutter you choose the shape of the piece and the mix of materials yourself. The delivery needs 1024 timber-frame panels of one specified family, not any thousand decorative blocks. The finish you pick shapes the look of the future building, so make a small sample first.

Place several panels together and check the pattern direction and its relationship to the supports. Once satisfied, prepare the cutter's materials for the large batch. Do not mix timber frames with similar-looking walls from another mod: the book counts a specific item type.

All 1,024 panels are consumed when claiming. The cathedral walls need separate construction stock; the book does not automatically assess architecture. Lay out passages, floor heights and lighting first so an attractive facade does not leave an awkward interior.
codex.quest.end_monuments.eternal_town.t: The Ultimate Bricks connect this building project to the late Eternal Tales route. You encountered them while preparing access to Ultimate World; now turn in 512 blocks, eight full stacks. Ordinary bricks and other interdimensional portal materials do not satisfy this objective.

Check sources for The Ultimate Bricks specifically: they occur in the Ultimate Portal structure and among Crabzilla's drops. Do not dismantle your only functioning transition before preparing a replacement and a return route. Reserve travel supplies before collecting the construction order.

Claiming consumes the bricks. A separate batch can become a square or workshop dedicated to the final world; this card does not verify restoration of an entire town. Decide the building's purpose and access first, then choose its scale and decorative materials.
A bastion begins with a working gun and a safe firing sector. Manufacture eight Create: Big Cannons nethersteel screw breeches and 128 HE shells for this industrial delivery. Nethersteel is this mod's separate material; the name does not mean an ordinary netherite ingot.

Complete one breech through its production chain, check compatibility with the chosen barrel and only then expand output. Store shells away from the test area. A finished shell body and ammunition correctly prepared for a particular shot are different stages of the process.

Claiming consumes the entire specified batch. Prepare barrels, mounts, charges and equipment for the actual battery separately. After construction, test aiming and firing on an empty range: nearby machinery and housing must remain outside the firing sector.
codex.quest.end_monuments.fortress.title: Bastion
codex.quest.end_monuments.guide_matrix_o: Run a small order from the matrix without a generator, then restore generation and verify charging

Battery capacity matters alongside the load it can support. Assemble a separate working induction matrix and connect a small workshop unrelated to reactor cooling or other sensitive systems. Ordinary processing machines are enough for the test.

Wait for a visible energy reserve, then disconnect only that workshop's external power source. Leave its cables and the matrix output connected. Start a short order and observe machines continuing to operate while stored energy decreases: this demonstrates actual delivery of the reserve.

Restore generation and confirm that charge rises again. Mark the check manually after both observations. If energy stays inside, inspect the output port mode, provider transfer limit and cable connection; adding cells alone does not repair incorrect wiring.
codex.quest.end_monuments.guide_rail_con: Deliver material by train between two stations, unload it and return the train

A railway connects production when useful cargo actually arrives on it. Choose two existing districts, such as a store and workshop or a mine and base. Build a separate working line and prepare a train capable of traversing it; tracks from the surrendered batch are no longer available for construction.

Install stations with distinguishable names. Load one chosen material into onboard storage, travel to the destination and unload it. Manual driving and cargo transfer are acceptable for the first trial: this checks whether the route itself works.

Return the train to its starting station and confirm only after the complete round trip. Check platform access, wagon clearance and sections where the train might stop. Automatic schedules are easier to add to a proven route than to use as a way of discovering track faults.
codex.quest.end_monuments.guide_spire_ac: Build two guarded work platforms, carry cargo between them and return to the exit

A tall frame is useful only if you can reach its work platforms with tools and cargo. After the girder delivery, choose a small section of the future spire and build two platforms at different levels connected by a safe passage. Their materials must be separate from the surrendered order.

Put a supply container upstairs and guard exposed edges. Travel from bottom to top and back using ordinary movement, without creative flight or temporary pillar jumping. Check that doors and turns leave access to the workstation clear.

Confirm the project after a full pass with cargo and a return to the exit. Height is not the point here; the point is a structure you can maintain. This section becomes the proven model for the other floors, before the tower grows so tall that redoing every passage becomes a torment.
codex.quest.end_monuments.matrix.text.0: In Mekanism's induction matrix each part has its own role: cells set the energy reserve, providers the speed of transfer. This order gathers a batch of 54 induction casings and eight ultimate induction cells. It is not a full blueprint of a matrix.
codex.quest.end_monuments.matrix.text.1: Check the cell upgrade chain and prepare intermediate tiers before starting the large order. A real installation also needs providers and ports, with a shell following Mekanism's multiblock rules. Do not dismantle your operating battery for this delivery.
codex.quest.end_monuments.matrix.text.2: All casings and cells must be in your inventory when claiming and will be consumed. The four ultimate providers awarded here can serve a separate matrix. Before connecting that battery, check port directions and whether the cables support the intended transfer rate.
codex.quest.end_monuments.matrix.title: Matrix
A shipyard becomes useful once you have built a small aircraft and understand its controls. Prepare 256 pearlescent levitite and 64 Aeronautics smart propellers. The order's quantity does not promise enough lift for every possible build: mass and vessel design still matter.

Separate lift-material production from propeller production, inspect the available recipes and supply their shared components. Before building a huge hull, test the intended arrangement on a compact craft: starting, stopping, turning and returning to its berth.

This card consumes its materials when you claim. Keep a separate reserve for the vessel itself. The navigation tables and gyroscopic mechanisms awarded here can equip the shipyard, but they do not replace testing the assembled craft and configuring its controls correctly.
codex.quest.end_monuments.shipyard.title: Shipyard
codex.quest.end_monuments.spire.text.0: Create metal girders suit structural frames, walkways and open industrial towers. Produce and turn in 1,024 girders here: sixteen full stacks. This is a production order, not an automatic measurement of your building's height.
codex.quest.end_monuments.spire.text.1: Open the girder recipe and reserve its ingredients separately. Check a small batch first, then route finished girders into a dedicated chest. A separate output reveals production bottlenecks and keeps the order apart from supplies for the working factory.
codex.quest.end_monuments.spire.text.2: Move all sixteen stacks into your regular inventory before claiming. They will be consumed; the future spire needs another construction batch. The brass casings and sturdy sheets awarded here can support machinery on its upper platforms.
codex.quest.end_monuments.spire.title: Spire
codex.quest.end_monuments.vault_city.tex: Sixteen drives holding 64,000 items each provide a combined capacity of 1,024,000 items. This counts stored objects, not a million distinct types. This delivery requires sixteen 64k storage parts and sixteen empty Refined Storage housings.

The parts grow through a chain of smaller capacities, and the top step calls for advanced processors. A part and a housing are easily turned into a disk, but here keep them apart. Disks from the running network need not be pulled out or handed in.

Move both batches into your ordinary inventory and collect the reward. The parts and housings vanish, while your network's contents stay untouched on its disks. In return come four 64k parts — a convenient start for expanding the working storage.
codex.quest.et_amber.crystal_amb.text.0: The Kingdom of Amber crystal requires Sorcery level thirteen. Its five creator slots contain Pharos, Illuminati Fish, Flame Sphere, a Truadamantite Ingot and a Crystal of Greatness. Check the rare fish and remaining ingots after armor crafting particularly early.
codex.quest.et_amber.crystal_amb.text.1: Lay out the components by the recipe, check your level on the board and take the crystal. The Flame Sphere here is an ingredient item; a creature that came out of a monster spawner will not fit in the slot.
codex.quest.et_amber.crystal_amb.text.2: Wait for item detection, then prepare your portal. Record its coordinates on first entry: Amber’s storyline uses this point when directing you to the maze and castle.
codex.quest.et_amber.crystal_amb.title: Amber Crystal
codex.quest.et_amber.enter_amb.text.0: Before first entering Amber, bring tools, healing and a Return Ticket. Record the first portal’s coordinates immediately after arrival; Nightingale’s later directions measure west and east from that point. It matters more than an unrelated camp built afterwards.
codex.quest.et_amber.enter_amb.text.1: Survey the surroundings, find local characters and establish a safe stop for storing loot. Set a clear route back before visiting large structures.
codex.quest.et_amber.enter_amb.text.2: This card checks the entry advancement and presence in the Kingdom of Amber. Find Nightingale and accept his assignment for the next story stage: visiting the world alone neither gives the maze key nor finishes the king’s storyline.
codex.quest.et_amber.enter_amb.title: Amber Lands
codex.quest.et_amber.greatness.text.0: The Crystal of Greatness is crafted from nine Shards of Greatness filling the crafting grid. Save these shards from earlier-stage loot and distinguish the finished crystal from similarly named runes. One complete crystal is needed for travel.
codex.quest.et_amber.greatness.text.1: Pharos is made from an Ayeris Bottle, Blaze Powder, Glowstone Dust and Geobstractsite Dust; the recipe produces four. This is a separate mod item, not a requirement to build a vanilla beacon pyramid.
codex.quest.et_amber.greatness.text.2: Obtain both outputs in your inventory and reserve one of each for the Amber crystal. Save surplus Pharos for other recipes; completing this card confirms prepared components rather than an already opened portal.
codex.quest.et_amber.greatness.title: Crystal of Greatness
codex.quest.et_amber.keybekium.text.0: Daredian is the in-game name of the metal whose internal name is keybekium. It is one and the same item, and the difference between the label and the technical name is not a recipe error. The raw material turns up along several connected routes, including Rayana and Eden.
codex.quest.et_amber.keybekium.text.1: Smelt Daredian Ore or Raw Daredian Ore in a furnace or blast furnace. Nine Daredian Metal Nuggets also make an ingot. Use an already accessible method rather than seeking a special machine merely because the name is unfamiliar.
codex.quest.et_amber.keybekium.text.2: Obtain one ingot in your inventory for detection and reserve the rest for tools. This material supports equipment chains and illustrates resource connections between dimensions.
codex.quest.et_amber.keybekium.title: Daredian
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.task.0: Explore Amber Maze and read the discovery revealing its secret
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.task.1: Complete Amber’s story: uncover Xaxxas XIX’s secret and defeat him
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.text.0: Nightingale gives you the maze’s front-door key and asks you to uncover the king’s secret. His reference places the maze roughly two thousand blocks west of your first Amber portal. Accept the assignment and take the key before leaving.
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.text.1: Inside, search for further keys, the planetary model and the tablet describing Amber’s agreement. Advance systematically and mark explored junctions; finding the building is different from reading the story discovery.
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.text.2: Revealing the secret leads toward the castle in the east. This card’s second advancement includes completing Amber’s story and defeating Xaxxas, so it may remain open until that battle. Read the king’s encounter instructions beforehand.
codex.quest.et_amber.maze.title: Amber Labyrinth
codex.quest.et_amber.smuciel.task.0: Kill Smuciel; collect the boss banner in your inventory
codex.quest.et_amber.smuciel.text.0: Smuciel is in Purgatorium’s grim church, the Scary Calvary described by Miguel. This card sits among later fights, but Amber’s castle is not the place to seek him. Return to Purgatorium and look for the church structure.
codex.quest.et_amber.smuciel.text.1: Bring healing and light, remember the way out, then search the church and challenge its master. Do not go in with a full inventory: you will need room for the trophy, and the way back through dark corridors can be hard.
codex.quest.et_amber.smuciel.text.2: Defeat Smuciel and collect his banner, which the advancement tracks. An ordinary monster in a similar building is not a substitute; check the opponent’s name and the mark after the encounter.
codex.quest.et_amber.smuciel.title: Smuciel
Truadamantite uses a mixed recipe: Brimstone Fungi, Tungsten, Netherite, Venetium and Adamantite Ingots, plus two Phantom Membranes. Prepare the whole batch and obtain your first ingot before crafting armor in quantity.

The armor advancement requires wearing the Truadamantite set. Assemble every piece, remove conflicting armor and check the mark after equipping it. A single ingot or stray helmet does not complete both objectives.
Set one ingot aside for the Amber crystal. Truadamantite both protects and opens the next route, so do not spend the whole first stock on upgrades before the crossing is prepared.
codex.quest.et_amber.truadamantite.title: Truadamantite
codex.quest.et_amber.xaxxas.task.0: Kill Xaxxas XIX; collect the boss banner in your inventory
codex.quest.et_amber.xaxxas.text.0: After revealing the maze’s secret, travel to Xaxxas’s castle: the story places it roughly two thousand blocks east of your first Amber portal. Bring the directions, repaired equipment, healing and blocks for safe progress.
codex.quest.et_amber.xaxxas.text.1: Apply the Crown of Amber to the Royal Altar while holding it in your main hand: the summon consumes the crown. During the fight keep the Amber warriors in mind and do not let them block the exit. Win yourself room first, then focus on the king.
codex.quest.et_amber.xaxxas.text.2: Collect the Royal Banner after victory; it is the advancement’s tracked trophy. Finish story conversations and return to Miguel’s line, which leads toward Unahzaal and preparation for his dimension.
codex.quest.et_amber.xaxxas.title: Xaxxas XIX
codex.quest.et_archaeology.blueprints.te: Blueprints enable crafting particular items; they are useful excavation results, not merely paper trophies. Brush suspicious blocks with a Venetium or Truadamantite Brush and collect finds until you obtain any blueprint.
Read the name and see which item the blueprint unlocks. Put the original straight into a separate chest, then list the missing materials. Not every blueprint is meant for the stage you are at.

Obtaining one qualifying blueprint completes this goal. The next card introduces the Shredder, but that device disposes of unwanted copies; preserve a useful original or duplicate it on the printer first.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.brush.task.1: Excavate Suspicious Block by Venetium or Truadamantite Brush
codex.quest.et_archaeology.brush.text.0: The Venetium Brush is used for Eternal Tales excavation and Archaeology development. Prepare it before investigating suspicious blocks: a pickaxe destroys the find and does not perform brushing. A Truadamantite Brush also qualifies for the advancement, but this card’s item objective specifically requests Venetium.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.brush.text.1: Walk up to a suspicious block and keep brushing until its contents come out. Drive off dangerous creatures first and do not dig out the support beneath the block — that way you finish the job in peace.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.brush.text.2: Collect the dropped item and check the advancement. You need both a Venetium Brush and a successful excavation with a qualifying tool; crafting alone is insufficient. This begins your supply of blueprints for the next branch.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.brush.title: Brushes
codex.quest.et_archaeology.guide_archive: Store one useful original blueprint separately from copies intended for the Shredder

Create a small archive before first using the Shredder. An ordinary chest is enough: reserve space for useful originals and label the future items they unlock. A few finds do not need a complicated sorting system.
Read one blueprint, identify its purpose and set the original aside. Keep papers intended for destruction separately so an accidental stack transfer does not cost a rare recipe.

The book will see the chest by itself; the saved original is for you to confirm. Tick it once the sorting is really done; in the next branch you will make a copy and make sure the archive survived recycling.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.guide_copy_re: Duplicate the archived blueprint in the printer, shred one copy, and verify that an original remains

Take the selected blueprint from the archive and prepare the printer with paper and ink. Make a copy, collect the result and immediately return one instance to the original’s storage position. Only then approach the Shredder.
Recycle the spare copy and check the change in Archaeology experience. The Shredder destroys the paper; this expected cost no longer removes your ability to craft the item.

Manually confirm the complete cycle when experience was gained and one blueprint still remains in the archive. This checks safe duplicate use rather than simply accumulating blueprints without deciding what to do with them.
The Jewelry Table processes rough gems and helps create archery equipment. Craft the table from a rough gem, Sandpaper, a Fletching Table and a Gold Ingot. Rough gems come from specified ores or creatures when using the Treasure Hunter enchantment, as listed in the reference.
Insert the gem and Sandpaper into the table; a Magnifying Glass improves output quality. Archery level also contributes, so an expensive magnifier does not replace character development.
This card requests three items: the table, magnifier and Sandpaper. Perform a trial processing operation separately to understand the interface before spending your rarest gem.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.jewelry.title: Jewelry Table
codex.quest.et_archaeology.rings.text.0: The Gold Ring is a clear introductory goal among jewelry accessories. Use the recipe for Eternal Tales’ Gold Ring specifically and prepare its components; a similarly named ring from another mod does not complete this advancement.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.rings.text.1: Obtain the finished ring in your inventory, then read its tooltip and check its valid equipment slot. To use it practically, equip the accessory correctly rather than carrying it among crafting materials.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.rings.text.2: This card tracks acquiring the Gold Ring, not its effect. Start by testing one accessory before comparing more elaborate rings, so you understand which benefit your rare resources are buying.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.rings.title: Rings
codex.quest.et_archaeology.sherds.task.0: Get Any Of Neodymium Pottery Sherds
codex.quest.et_archaeology.sherds.text.0: Neodymium Pottery Sherds and Vases form a separate archaeological collection. Save excavated sherds by their displayed type; ordinary vanilla pottery fragments do not necessarily qualify for the mod’s objectives.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.sherds.text.1: Obtain any Neodymium Pottery Sherd, then craft or find a qualifying Neodymium Vase. Check the chosen vase’s own recipe, because similar appearance does not guarantee identical ingredients.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.sherds.text.2: The two advancements check different stages: obtaining a fragment and a finished object. Avoid spending the last needed sherd before the first mark registers. Keep the collection near your archaeological tools so future discoveries can immediately contribute to known recipes.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.sherds.title: Sherds and Vases
codex.quest.et_archaeology.shredder.task: Shred an unwanted blueprint for Archaeology experience; the blueprint is destroyed
codex.quest.et_archaeology.shredder.text: The Shredder exchanges blueprints for Archaeology development, destroying the submitted copy. This is useful for duplicates but unsuitable for storing your only rare blueprint. Choose an unwanted copy for the exercise and move valuable originals away from the work area.
Open the Shredder, put in the chosen blueprint and run it. Look at Archaeology before and after: the number should go up. A blueprint lying in an idle machine gives nothing.

The advancement specifically requires destroying a blueprint in the Shredder. Losing that item is the expected price of the action, not a book error. Once understood, the cycle gives repeated finds a use instead of accumulating endless identical papers.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.totems.text.0: Archaeology totems are distinct items connected with excavation and later crafting. Keep unusual materials and blueprints, then choose an accessible totem by its recipe and tooltip. Do not confuse them with vanilla Totems of Undying or Eternal Darkness switches.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.totems.text.1: Obtain any item accepted by the archaeology totem advancement. Read its effect and conditions before use: the word totem does not imply that all items in the group work identically.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.totems.text.2: Acquisition alone completes this card, so a dangerous experiment is unnecessary. First determine whether its effect supports your activity, then include it in expedition preparations.
codex.quest.et_archaeology.totems.title: Ceramic Totems
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.task.0: Tame Comethorn by Geobstractsite Bush or Tubes
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.text.0: Tame Comethorns with Geobstractsite Bushes or Tubes, as explicitly stated by the advancement. Prepare a reserve of a qualifying material and find a Comethorn in Comets, approaching on level ground away from island edges.
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.text.1: Interact using the appropriate item and watch for signs of taming. Do not replace interaction with an attack or assume that one feeding guarantees success; use the creature’s state and the advancement as confirmation.
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.text.2: After taming, provide a safe place and observe its behavior before leading it across bridges. This card specifically asks for taming: killing a Comethorn or collecting materials does not complete this peaceful branch.
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.title: Comethorn
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.text.0: The Comets crystal is made in the Interdimensional Creator at Sorcery level two. You need Ancienzyte-Framed Bleedwood, Inverted Mud, a Terra Crystal, Grave Dirt and a Hyacinthum Gold Block. Check the form of every component: it has to be the gold block, the creator will not take an ingot.
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.text.1: Check your level on the board, arrange the five components according to the recipe and take the crystal. If there is no result, verify the items and your personal skill before rebuilding a portal.
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.text.2: This card requests the crystal itself. Travel separately requires the corresponding interdimensional bricks and an activated portal. Pack a Return Ticket and building blocks before your first step into the new world.
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.title: Comets Crystal
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.text.0: Before entering Comets, pack a Return Ticket, food, lighting and several stacks of building blocks. The portal must use this dimension’s bricks and crystal. Check supplies before entering: gaps between islands may be too wide to jump safely.
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.text.1: On arrival, inspect the landing area, record the portal coordinates and secure any dangerous edge. Build short supported crossings and avoid spending your entire block reserve decorating the first camp.
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.text.2: Completion requires the entry advancement and being in Comets. Then search for local ores and Aerolite; a camp near the portal lets you remove loot in stages without risking the entire haul in one trip.
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.title: First Step
codex.quest.et_comets.guide_island_route: Build a safe route from the portal to another island and walk both ways without jumping over the void
Choose a neighboring island with a useful resource and plan a short route from the portal. Bring at least a stack of building material, inspect both sides of the gap and leave a return reserve.
Build a stable crossing with protection along dangerous edges. Walk it in both directions without relying on jumps across the void or temporary flight. Mark the portal direction near its ends.

Confirm the manual objective after a complete outward and return walk. The cobblestone stack checks supplies, not a finished bridge; this route makes exporting metals and leading tamed creatures safer.
codex.quest.et_comets.guide_tragedy_tool: Prepare a Tragedy Axe and an Asteroid Stone reserve before fighting the Terrible Tree. The axe combines an Aerolite Axe with four Grave Dirt blocks; check the finished item name rather than arriving with an ordinary tool.
Asteroid Stone is not used to summon the Tree. It will be needed later to interact with the living Rock-Blaze, so collecting it now is easier than returning to Comets during the next encounter.
Get both items and keep the stone apart from bridge-building blocks. This preparation ties two encounters together — but the Tree still has to be beaten by you in person.
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.text.0: Icelands is a distinct Comets biome and the target of an exploration trip. Bring building blocks, food and a return method, then search for cold areas among the islands. Mark crossings so the return journey does not require repeating dangerous jumps.
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.text.1: Enter the biome you have found and wait for the advancement. Ice in your inventory or a snowy island on the horizon do not count: your character has to set foot on that ground.
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.text.2: Record coordinates and samples of local materials. This location supports later cold-related recipes and the highest Ekatebrina tier; reconnaissance is sufficient now, without preparing a difficult fight on your first discovery.
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.title: Icelands
Clear the cave from Comets Fleas
The Strange Banshee in Comets asks you to clear Comets Fleas from the area around its former home. Find the character first, accept Insect Control and inspect the Journal counter. Do not assume kills made before acceptance count as completed work.

Travel to the crater and cave containing the ruined house, defeat the specified fleas and monitor progress. Bring blocks for descending and mark a clear return route because the terrain contains gaps and drops.

Return to the Banshee and finish the conversation when the required count is reached. The objective checks the Comets assignment, so clearing the area alone is insufficient. Save the rewards and the character’s coordinates for future visits.
codex.quest.et_comets.quest_comets.title: Comets Quest
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.text.0: Skylite and Aerolite supply Comets tools and the next crystal. Obtain a Skylite Ingot by processing the corresponding raw material, and look for Aerolite among local finds and structure loot. Secure routes between islands first.
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.text.1: Keep Aerolite Nuggets and Ingots distinct: this advancement checks a nugget, while later progression recipes use ingots and tools. Pick up the required form before consolidating the whole reserve.
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.text.2: After both objectives register, prepare an Aerolite Axe for the Tragedy Axe. Save some metals for Hell Fire and the Purgatorium crystal; spending the first batch entirely on decoration means another expedition later.
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.title: Skylite and Aerolite
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.task.0: Kill Terrible Tree; collect the boss banner in your inventory
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.text.0: Summon the Terrible Tree by breaking a Comet Log with a Tragedy Axe. Craft that axe from an Aerolite Axe and four Grave Dirt blocks. Choose an accessible comet tree on ground with room to move and no open edge immediately behind you.
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.text.1: Repair your weapon and prepare healing and retreat space before chopping. Break the correct Comet Log with the required axe, then fight on solid ground while clearing interfering creatures.
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.text.2: The victory has to bring your personal advancement — without it Rock-Blaze cannot be summoned, and ready-made Hell Fire will not get around that check. After the fight keep the drops and go back for the next summoning materials.
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.title: Terrible Tree
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.text.0: A Totem of Eternal Darkness enables Eternal Darkness; a Totem of Eternity disables it. Distinguish these similar names during preparation: the first strengthens the game’s conditions, while the second restores normal mode.
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.text.1: Use the right totem somewhere safe, with gear and healing prepared beforehand. The state of the mode is shown on the Notice Board. Darkness strengthens creatures and bosses, unlocks Humanity and Fear, and gives some items new properties.
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.text.2: The advancement confirms activation, not defeating every boss at the new difficulty. You may reverse the mode after a short test using the prepared totem; decide whether to continue in Darkness before beginning another expensive summon.
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.title: Activation
codex.quest.et_darkness.guide_mode_rever: Use a Totem of Eternity after activating Darkness and verify on the board that the mode is disabled

Reversing the mode is part of preparing difficulty experiments. Obtain a Totem of Eternity and keep it separate from summoning supplies so the correct item is easy to find. Do not confuse it with a Totem of Eternal Darkness or Totem of Death.
After activating Darkness, use the prepared totem somewhere safe and open the board. Check that the mode is actually disabled before returning to construction or trying unfamiliar devices.

Tick the card only after that check. A totem in your bag is not yet a cancelled mode; once the sequence is second nature, you will record activation advancements separately and prepare fights under the right conditions.
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.text.0: Humanity appears in Eternal Darkness and shifts with whom you kill. According to the reference, victories over evil creatures raise it and speed up essence regeneration, while killing the good ones lowers the scale and slows regeneration.
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.text.1: Record the starting value on the board and observe changes after selected fights. Do not infer the target from the technical advancement name get_100_humanity: its description asks for positive one thousand Humanity, not one hundred.
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.text.2: Raise the value to the required positive amount and wait for the mark. Noxifer and Luciden later require much more extreme values of opposite signs, so this stage introduces managing the scale.
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.title: Humanity
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.task.0: Kill Noxifer Forever Blinded; collect the boss banner in your inventory
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.task.1: Kill Luciden The Starlight Warrior; collect the boss banner in your inventory
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.text.0: Both bosses require Eternal Darkness but opposite Humanity values. Summon Noxifer with a Daredian Moon at no higher than −10000 Humanity. Summon Luciden with Forge of the Light at no lower than +10000. One prepared value cannot serve both summons.
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.text.1: Choose one opponent first, check the value on the board and prepare a separate arena with healing. Apply the corresponding item to a block; a successful summon consumes it. If it fails, check the sign and mode before crafting unnecessary copies.
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.text.2: Collect the banner and check the advancement after victory, then prepare the other side of the scale. Both victories are required, making this a long-term Humanity task.
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.title: Noxifer and Luciden
Calamity Ring, Harpy Ring and Ring of Crimson Tears are three separate accessories. Find an accessible recipe or source for each and keep the finished result in your inventory until its mark appears. A similar ring from another system is not a substitute.

Prepare the Calamity Ring particularly carefully because it is part of a separate difficult Unahzaal victory condition. Before fighting, check its required equipment method as well as possession; carrying it among materials may not satisfy combat conditions.
This card checks only obtaining the three rings. Learn their effects individually, avoid enabling every dangerous mode merely for the collection, and keep control of Humanity for the next objective.
codex.quest.et_darkness.rings_dark.title: Rings of Darkness
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.task.1: Defeat Unahzaal’s final phase in Eternal Darkness with Calamity Ring equipped and Humanity ≤−5000
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.text.0: Super Duper Darkness is switched on with a Totem of Death and turns on Eternal Darkness along with it. Any damage taken in this mode kills on the spot. For the first try keep a Totem of Eternity ready, choose an enclosed safe place and rule out falls, fire and stray visitors.
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.text.1: Activating this mode is the first objective. The second separately requires defeating Unahzaal’s final phase in Eternal Darkness with the Calamity Ring equipped and Humanity no higher than −5000. Activation does not replace the fight; Super Duper Darkness itself is not required for this victory.
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.text.2: Check the advancements independently. After activation registers, reverse the dangerous mode if you intend to prepare the fight in ordinary Eternal Darkness; verify the ring and Humanity in advance.
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.title: Super Duper Darkness
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.text.0: Adam and Eve are separate late opponents; this card does not mean you should immediately search for them among ordinary Eden residents. They are connected with later Arkemer story dialogues, so return to this collection as the Aftermath line unfolds.
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.text.1: Each fight gets its own healing reserve and sound equipment. Watch the enemy’s name and the advancement marks: beating one does not close the other half, and a look-alike automaton will not stand in for the boss you need.
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.text.2: Check credit and preserve trophies after each battle. This branch collects both victories and can remain open while you continue normal dimension progression and uncover the later story.
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.title: Adam and Eve
