Feed the full set, the fluid and FE, wait for the new frame and take out the result. While a matching recipe runs, the chamber locks its item slots and so protects the batch from mixing. A higher frame does not upgrade placed machines by itself: every device is still built by its own recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.frames.title: Machine Frames
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.guide_dissol: Manual: run the Simple frame recipe in a dissolution chamber, remove output and verify readiness for another batch.

The dissolution chamber makes materials from a set of items and one suitable fluid. For a separate test take the already familiar simple frame recipe and set aside the exact ingredients. A surplus of similar plates or another latex product will not replace the required composition.

Feed the fluid into the correct input, connect FE and load the full set of items. The chamber's recipes are shapeless: position in the grid does not matter, but type and quantity do. Once it recognises the recipe, the chamber locks the slots and admits no stray next batch.

Wait for the result, take it out and make sure the slots unlocked for a repeat, then tick the goal. If the machine waits, inspect the fluid and the energy reserve before rearranging all the items. This check prepares predictable frame making, and frames are where complex farms and mining devices begin.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.guide_log_su: Manual: obtain latex, replace an exhausted log and verify extraction resumes.

The fluid extractor slowly eats the wood in front of it, so the latex line needs logs put back. Prepare a separate working log block and a stock of identical logs. The working side must face the consumable, not the workshop's wooden wall.

Wait for the wood to be processed while watching the latex and the log itself. When the resource is exhausted, put the next block in the same place and make sure extraction resumes. Electricity speeds the extractor up, but it creates no new wood and clears no full fluid output.

Log replaced, latex flowing again; the manual goal can be ticked. Further automation will need supported block placement, but confirming the simple manual cycle first is worthwhile. Different logs give different yields; check the recipe if you want to switch to a more available species.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.0: The laser drill charges a suitable laser base, and it is the base that produces the yield. The quest names the fluid base, so expect no chest of ore from it. Ore has its own Ore Laser Base, made separately.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.1: Place the drill so its working area covers the base and supply FE. For a fluid recipe check the biome, the chosen depth and the catalyst; some recipes need a particular creature under the installation. A coloured lens is no universal pass to any fluid.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.2: Pick one recipe and prepare room for the result before adding more drills. The black and blue lenses make sense only under their recipe's conditions. If the base is full of energy yet yields nothing, check the world requirements and the catalyst instead of raising power blindly: energy is no substitute for a missing condition.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.title: Laser Drilling
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.0: Industrial Foregoing plastic begins with latex, which the fluid extractor draws from a log in front of its working side. The extractor is not on the goal list; make it separately. The wood is gradually consumed and disappears; there is no eternal latex from a single log.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.1: Send the latex into the processing unit with water and supply power. The dry rubber is then smelted into plastic by the available recipe. Watch the form of the rubber: the small intermediate material and whole dry rubber may need extra assembly.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.2: First show the book eight dry rubber in one batch, then process the material and collect sixteen plastic; different item goals are remembered in turn. If it stops, check the log, the water, the latex and a free output, then the electricity. Keep the farm's wood and the workshop walls apart: the extractor should eat the material meant for it, not part of the base.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.title: Latex
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.ore_meat.tex: Meat metallurgy processes ore with Industrial Foregoing's special fluids. Prepare a source of liquid meat and a separate stock of ore. The Washing Factory combines ore with meat and yields raw ore meat; water cannot replace this input.

Pass the solution into the Fermentation Station, set the mode and the fill level at which the chamber seals the batch. Wait for fermentation, then send the resulting fluid with sand into the Fluid Sieving Machine. The output is metal dust of the original material.

Connect FE to every machine and keep the fluids separate by stage, never mixing metals in an unfinished volume. The dust still has to be smelted into ingots. If the fermenter waits, look at the batch sealing threshold: a partly filled tank may be normal waiting rather than a broken recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.stonework.te: The stonework factory combines the making and further processing of ordinary mineral materials. Supply energy, water and lava to the designated inputs, then choose the sequence of operations in the interface. Open lava nearby is not yet a filled internal tank.

Let plain cobblestone come out into a separate chest first. Once it runs steadily, enable the processing you need, crushing or smelting, by the available modes. Several operations change the final product, so route the result into a configured warehouse only after checking the chain.

FE and a free output need constant attention. The machine is good for sand, glass and building stock, but it does not replace laser mining of rare ores. The block itself counts at once; consider the factory working after a specific product and a restart once the full receiver has been emptied.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.glowstone.tex: A refined glowstone tool needs the matching Mekanism ingot, not glowstone dust standing in for metal. Prepare the osmium compressor, osmium and glowstone, then make the refined material. The compressor, in turn, needs electricity.

Make the pickaxe from the ingots at the crafting table. Check its stats and the ores it can mine before the trip, then try it on stone. The pickaxe needs no charging, though its metal was born in an electric machine.

Keep some glowstone for other recipes and watch the durability. Armour from the same material has properties of its own that are checked separately; do not ascribe them to the pickaxe. This step suits the moment when the compressor already runs and you want better ordinary gear before the expensive Meka-Tool.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.0: The lapis pickaxe gives lapis a use beyond enchanting and dye. Gather the material by its recipe and compare its stats with your current pickaxe before spending the stock set aside for the enchanting table. It is an ordinary Mekanism Tools item, not an electric machine.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.1: Craft the pickaxe at the crafting table and try it on plain stone near the base. Check that the ore you want yields to this tool: with the wrong mining level there will be no useful drop. The material's name guarantees no access to every ore.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.2: Durability deserves attention, and a spare tool will serve you in the mine. The pickaxe lasts with ordinary enchantments and repair under the item's rules. The branch is optional for Mekanism machines and gives a handy early tool without spending osmium on electric gear.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.title: Lapis Lazuli
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.obsidian.task: Obtain any refined-obsidian armour piece; the helmet meets the criterion.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.obsidian.text: Refined obsidian is a late material for ordinary Mekanism Tools gear. It is made from obsidian dust with diamond substance and further processing with osmium. Walk the whole chain through Mekanism machines: the armour recipe expects the ingot, not an obsidian block.

Make the helmet and the pickaxe and keep both items until the goals register. The "Better than netherite" advancement here checks for obtaining any refined obsidian armour piece, not a full set: the helmet is enough.

Compare protection and durability with your current gear and try the pickaxe on safe material. This armour gains no radiation shielding merely for coming from Mekanism. The reactor site still needs the protective kit; good ordinary armour handles other dangers.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.task.1: Obtain a paxel of any supported material; an osmium paxel qualifies.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.0: The paxel combines pickaxe, axe and shovel and frees up hotbar space. For the osmium version prepare the tools and the other ingredients of its recipe. Leave expensive enchanted blanks alone until you have checked that the recipe keeps the properties you want.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.1: Make the osmium paxel and keep it in your inventory for the item goal. The "Paxel" advancement triggers on obtaining any supported paxel, so no special blocks need mining for it: the osmium one already qualifies.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.2: Try stone, dirt and wood on safe ground and check the alternate use. The tool wears, and a chargepad will not restore it. Watch the durability and keep a spare pickaxe: losing one all-purpose tool takes several functions away at once.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.title: Osmium
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.task.1: Obtain a Mekanism Tools shield; an osmium shield qualifies for the advancement.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.0: The osmium shield is Mekanism Tools protective gear. Prepare osmium and the other ingredients, make the shield and look at its stats. The quest wants the osmium item specifically, though the advancement accepts several of the mod's materials.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.1: The advancement is granted for getting a supported shield into your inventory. No special blow needs blocking and no dangerous foe needs provoking. Once counted, put the shield in your preferred hand and test a plain raise in a safe place.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.2: The shield wears and protects only within the blocking mechanic. It provides no radiation shielding, no oxygen reserve and no protection from electrical devices. Watch its durability and remember the occupied hand when tools, food and a bucket are needed on the road.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.title: Shields
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.0: The generator coil turns Create rotation into electricity, but only when surrounded by magnets. Prepare the coil, carbon brushes, four magnetite blocks and a separate mechanical source. The coil creates no rotation and will not start a closed loop without outside energy.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.1: Arrange the magnets around the coil as the Ponder scene shows, bring in rotation and fit the brushes to draw off electricity. Connect a simple consumer or storage. Watch the mechanical network's load and the electrical output together: visible rotation does not yet say the magnetic part is assembled right.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.2: A stronger magnetic surround means more conversion and more mechanical load. If the network stalls from overload, reduce the load or strengthen the drive. The parts close the item goal; only rising energy in the receiving device speaks of real generation.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.title: Generator Coil
The energiser processes items with electricity and needs Create rotation at the same time. For the first batch, place the basic device above a depot or belt and provide both connections. A mechanical arm or an FE source without rotation does not satisfy the full set of conditions.

Put an iron ingot under the working part and wait for it to be processed. The installed overcharged iron recipe takes a thousand units of energy per ingot. Repeat for eight ingots and make sure the belt does not carry the material away before the operation finishes.

If the device stands idle, compare the item's position, the rotation supplied and the electrical reserve. Belt speed and processing must agree; a depot is easier to watch for the first test. Overcharged iron goes into later electrical components, so keep part of the batch for new mechanisms and until the goal registers.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.energiser.title: Energiser
codex.quest.tech2_newage.guide_conversio: Manual: power a separate consumer from the coil and verify generation stops when the original rotation stops.

Test the boundary between rotation and electricity on one small rig. Take a mechanical drive, a coil with magnets, brushes and a separate electrical consumer. Break any possible feedback so the rotation source does not depend on the generator under test and the picture stays clear.

Run the drive with no electrical load and look at the state of the mechanical network. Connect the consumer and make sure energy really flows into it while the network stays within its limit. Stop the rotation and watch generation cease, allowing for the charge already stored.

Power delivered, source stopped under control; tick the manual goal. Only your own observation counts here. If the device keeps running for a while, that is an internal battery, not endless energy. Such an experiment helps plan remote motors and gauge the reserve of the original mechanical power.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.guide_heat_rout: Manual: without nuclear fuel, verify heat delivery to a consumer and cooling after heat input stops.

The heat network deserves a test before a nuclear source is connected. Prepare weak, controllable heating, a few pipes and a Stirling engine or another suitable consumer. Keep the heat readings in view and move the rig away from flammable floors and player walkways.

Supply heat and follow its path to the consumer. Make sure the right side of the engine is connected and the expected rotation appears. Stop heating and watch the stored heat being used up without taking apart the still-hot line.

Supply, consumption and cooling checked without nuclear fuel; tick the manual goal. Do not drive blocks to the point of turning into lava for the sake of the experiment. A successful small test confirms the route, not that it will bear a full reactor: a powerful source needs its own calculation and constant removal.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.0: New Age heat pipes carry heat between supported devices. The Stirling engine gets rotation from heating below, and the boiler heater passes heat into Create's steam system. None of these blocks is an FE cable or a gas pipe.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.1: For the first experiment take a controllable heat source, a solar heating plate for example, and a short route to the engine. Watch temperature and rotation without connecting a large mechanical shop. Study the heater's placement under a boiler separately in Ponder.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.2: Too much heat is dangerous: an overheated heat block can turn into lava. Keep a constant heat consumer and do not trap a hot source in a dead end after the engine stops. Pipes, engine and heater in a chest are only equipment; the heat balance is checked on an assembled system.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.title: Heat
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.0: The electric motor turns received energy into Create rotation. It saves a remote machine that no long shaft can reach. Prepare the basic motor, its extension and steady power; a coil turned by that same motor will be no free source.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.1: Set the motor's speed with the wrench and connect one small machine. Changing speed by itself does not raise the SU load budget. The extension changes the load multiplier, but energy use grows along with the ability you choose.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.2: Check the behaviour when the consumer stops and under a redstone signal. By default the signal may switch the motor off, and the mode allows inversion; test your own setting specifically. On overload, reduce the mechanical load or tune the extension with the power supply in mind rather than cranking the speed to the maximum.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.title: Motors
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.0: The New Age reactor releases heat through fuel rods and heat vents. It is a different design from the Mekanism reactor. Assemble the rods, the fuel acceptor and the vents as Ponder shows, then close the reactor completely with casings or reactor glass before any fuel goes in.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.1: Run pipes from the heat vents to permanent consumers sized for the heat released. Before starting, check the whole route and access to the fuel cut-off. The sixteen casings in the quest are a starter stock, not a guarantee of a complete shell for the shape you chose.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.2: Ponder warns: an open reactor radiates, and without heat consumption it melts down. During the first test do not leave the installation unattended and do not open the shell for repairs. Start with a minimal controlled feed and watch the temperatures; the parts speak of equipment, not of a safe heat regime.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.title: Nuclear Reactor
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.0: New Age thorium is the raw material for the mod's own nuclear fuel. Radioactive thorium comes from crushing the ordinary kind, and the installed recipe yields it with a ten percent chance: eight starting units promise no successful batch. Stock up on material and room for the other crushing results.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.1: The fuel is made by Create sequenced assembly: the radioactive blank is pressed, an iron plate is added by the deployer and it is pressed again. The order matters; ordinary smelting of thorium in a furnace will not replace this chain. Check the current sequenced assembly recipe before launching the line.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.2: Keep eight ordinary thorium and the finished fuel until the goals register. Do not load the fuel into a reactor yet: a complete protective shell and heat removal come first. The radioactive part is obtained by chance, so plan on a reserve rather than an exact yield from every stack.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.title: Thorium
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.0: New Age wires carry electricity between connectors. Prepare two connectors and copper wire and choose a short link from a proven generator to a consumer. Mechanical shafts carry rotation separately and do not replace the energiser's electrical line.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.1: Fit the connectors to the right devices and join them with wire the way the mod prescribes. If a block pushes energy out by itself, a correct receiving connection is enough. For a passive source from another mod the connector has a Pull mode switched with the wrench.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.2: Check that the receiver's charge rises under a small load. Ponder separately warns that Pull is not for draining the internal reserve of a motor or energiser: do not build reverse network feeding on it. If transfer fails, inspect the modes and end blocks first, then the link's length and integrity.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.title: Wires
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.derrick.task: Manual: form the derrick, finish concrete-and-water drilling, create the wellhead and direct fluid into available storage.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.derrick.text: The derrick creates a wellhead to a surveyed reservoir. Build the multiblock by the manual and form it with the hammer on the single light engineering block. Prepare energy, drill pipes and the materials of both drilling stages; underwater this work cannot be done.

The first stage lines the well above bedrock with liquid concrete; the second drills through bedrock with water toward the chosen targets. Pipes are loaded by hand. Check the target coordinates in the interface and the right fluid, without mixing concrete and water in one unfinished feed.

Once the well is open, reservoir pressure drives the fluid upward. Provide drainage before drilling ends: an overfilled derrick dumps oil outside through its relief mechanism. Tick the manual goal after the wellhead is created and the fluid is received under control; a stack of parts says nothing about a working well.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.guide_desulf: Manual: form the hydrotreater, process sulfurized diesel with water and collect clean diesel together with sulfur dust.

Clean Petroleum diesel comes from the sulfurous fraction through further processing. Build the high-pressure multiblock plant by the engineer's manual and form it with the hammer. The name has nothing to do with PneumaticCraft: this is Petroleum's own process, with fluids and FE.

Feed a thousand units of sulfurous diesel and five hundred of water. The installed recipe yields a thousand clean diesel and five sulfur dust, so prepare a fluid and an item output. Energy enters the heating section; water goes to its own top port next to the panel.

Collect both products and tick the manual goal after the recipe has genuinely run. Do not substitute ordinary IE biodiesel for the sulfurous fraction because the name is similar. Sulfur needs a free output or processing halts; the powder will serve later chemistry.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.guide_survey: The survey result holds the reservoir data without which no well can be planned. Prepare the seismic tool and a suitable IE buckshot cartridge. Choose the survey point with access for future construction, not just a pretty spot for the derrick.

Carry out the survey and receive the result item. Open it and look at the measurement coordinates and the marks of possible deposits. Repeated, well-spaced surveys compare directions and refine the target; a first vague mark promises no specific fluid.

Keep the map with the project materials and write down the chosen coordinates. It replaces no well and yields no oil by itself. Before drilling, estimate the distance to storage and the means of draining fluid under pressure: the right site is decided not only by the deposit but by how serviceable the future installation will be.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.products.tex: Bitumen from distillation goes into asphalt, and lubricant into servicing suitable heavy machinery. Make sixteen asphalt blocks by the recipe and an auto-lubricator. Asphalt is good for a road across the industrial site, but it will not stand in for a multiblock's material.

Hold the lubricator next to a supported machine: the highlight shows the attachment point. Install it there and supply permitted lubricant. The manual names the pumpjack, the excavator and the crusher, for instance; a random machine from another mod is not necessarily compatible.

Check fluid consumption and the signs of lubrication on a working mechanism. Plant oil works too, but it is spent less economically than petroleum lubricant. Acceleration cures no empty input or blocked output, so restore the machine's normal operation first and only then judge the value of servicing.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.pumpjack.tas: Manual: form a pumpjack over a completed wellhead after reservoir pressure falls, supply FE and collect fluid through a side output.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.pumpjack.tex: The pumpjack draws fluid from a wellhead the derrick has already drilled. It is needed once the reservoir's natural pressure has dropped. Do not replace the derrick too early: a pressurised well spews fluid through the pump assembly, and a reserve in the tank does not change that.

Build the structure by the manual, align the head pipe connection with the wellhead and strike the heavy engineering block of the second layer with the hammer. Bring in FE and join the orange side outputs to storage. Make sure it is the prepared well bore that is selected.

Start extraction and follow the incoming fluid, then tick the manual goal. Energy use and speed are set by configuration, and the deposit is finite; some reservoirs slowly refill. If extraction dries up, look at the reservoir's state and a free output; moving the pumpjack creates no new oil.
The Petroleum seismic survey tool looks for fluid deposits below bedrock. It needs IE buckshot cartridges: load suitable ammunition and use the tool at a prepared spot. The map shows reflected signals, and several well-spaced readings pin the reservoir down.

Compare the results and write down the coordinates of the future well. Not every mark is oil: deposits vary, and the first signal may not reveal the type. Before building an expensive derrick, double-check what the survey results show.

The IE core sample from the second goal belongs to mineral surveying and does not replace the Petroleum seismic result. It comes from the ordinary sample drill, but it proves no oil deposit. Later you will need separate storage for the extracted fluid and a clear site for the derrick.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.survey.title: Survey
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.task.3: Manual: form and power a distillation tower, process crude oil and provide reception for every fluid fraction and bitumen.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.0: The distillation tower splits oil into naphtha, kerosene, sulfurous diesel and lubricant, and gives bitumen on top. Build it by the manual, form it with the hammer on the redstone engineering block and prepare intake for every product: one blocked fraction halts all processing.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.1: Energy enters at the top of the heating section, oil at the bottom; fluids leave through the orange side hatch and bitumen at the front. The four buckets of clean diesel in the quest also need the high-pressure plant: a thousand sulfurous diesel and five hundred water give a thousand clean diesel plus sulfur dust.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.2: The flare stack burns permitted flammable surplus rather than storing it; its top is dangerous even during maintenance. Set up the useful receivers first, then the controlled flare. Tick the manual goal after distillation runs with reachable outputs; make and register clean diesel separately after desulfurisation.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.title: Distillation Tower
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.0: Pneumatic armour runs on a reserve of compressed air and installable upgrades. The helmet and chestplate from the quest open the set, and the charging station fills supported items with air. Prepare the station and a safely controlled network before making many modules.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.1: Put an armour piece on the station and watch the pressure equalise between them. The station's small air reserve will not fill a large empty item without a compressor. Compatible upgrades are also installed through the station's interface; the list depends on the gear.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.2: Put on the charged pieces and learn the controls in a safe place. The full set and its special abilities need the remaining pieces and modules. Do not raise the whole early network to an item's limit: ordinary tubes hold less than some tools, and safety is set by the weakest connected block.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.title: Pneumatic Armor
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.assembly.tex: The pneumatic assembly line drills and lasers by program. The controller, platform, drill and laser from the quest are not the whole kit: you also need two IO units and an assembly program bought through Amadron or from a mechanic villager.

Put the platform in the middle of a clear area. The drill and the laser must stand directly adjacent, not diagonally; the IO units must reach both the platform and their chests. Set one to import, the other to export. Supplying air to the controller of the linked system is enough.

Insert the program and run one familiar recipe while watching the controller's diagnostics. The "drill and laser" program means two operations in sequence, not every recipe of both tools at once. If it stops, check the chosen program, the platform's reach, the air and the material in the right chest.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.chamber.text: The pressure chamber is a hollow box three, four or five blocks along each outer side. Edges and corners are built from chamber walls or glass, and valves and interfaces go on the faces. The eight walls in the quest are not enough for the full minimum shell.

Build the starting chamber and bring air to at least one valve. Convenient feeding takes two interfaces: an input with the letter I facing out and an output with O facing out. Items are fed by a hopper or transport from outside, not by opening the shell.

Let compressed iron be the first recipe, and watch the pressure. Moving items through the interfaces spends air too, so a stalled output may just be waiting for pressure to recover. Do not dismantle a full chamber for the result: set up the output and the compressor. For bulk iron, process blocks; there will be fewer transfers.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressed.t: The first compressed iron is made by explosion: ordinary iron ingots lie on the ground and the blast presses them. It is the starting operation of PneumaticCraft; without it the pressure chamber cannot be built. Prepare a small batch of iron and a site far from the base, animals and anything valuable.

Drop only the intended ingots next to a controlled source of explosion and step back into cover before it goes off. Then pick up the surviving compressed iron. The manual warns of losing roughly a fifth of the material, so exactly sixteen ingots promise no goal.

Do not make up for a stroke of bad luck with a heap of valuables next to the explosives. With sixteen compressed ingots in hand, move on to the compressor and the chamber: later the chamber makes compressed iron without blast losses and becomes the ordinary, controlled way of supply.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressor.t: The air compressor burns ordinary furnace fuel and produces compressed air. Prepare the compressor, four tubes and a manometer and leave room to watch from. This compressor will not take a bucket of lava: liquid fuel is for a different device.

Join the compressor to a consumer with a short tube, close the unused sides and load a little fuel. Check the pressure with the manometer and in the interface. Hissing and particles at an open end are a leak to fix before increasing production.

An early system is rated for a nominal limit of five bar; the red zone on the gauge warns of danger rather than setting a working target. Set the compressor to cut off before that limit and check that it stops without consumption. A fuel compressor must not pump into a closed network unattended.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.0: A drone executes a recorded program and consumes compressed air. The programmer is for composing actions; the GPS tool carries coordinates. The programmer needs no pressure, but the program may need puzzle pieces, and the drone is charged at a station before takeoff.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.1: Let the first job be moving one kind of item between two chests. Set exact input and output areas, write the program into the deployed drone and test it near the base. Do not open the acquaintance with a command to mine a large area or one with no item limits.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.2: Set up a charging station with the required dispenser upgrade and access to air so the drone can be serviced. A fully drained drone stops flying and may crash. When moving a program elsewhere, update the coordinates: correct actions with someone else's coordinates send the helper astray.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.title: Drone
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.elevator.tex: The pneumatic elevator carries a platform between floors. The base and frames set the route, but a working elevator also needs air and floor controls. Before installing, choose a vertical shaft free of protruding machines, wires and spots where the player could get stuck.

Assemble the base and frames by the manual and connect a short, safe air line. Set the heights and controls, then make a short ride without cargo. Check the platform's whole path, not just the free block above the base.

Provide an ordinary emergency exit from the floors in case the compressor stops. If the elevator freezes, compare the pressure, the chosen height and obstacles in the shaft. The four frames in the quest promise no particular height: the result depends on the assembled structure and its settings, and those must be tested before everyday use.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_assemb: The drill and the laser do not take items from a neighbouring chest on their own. The assembly system needs separate import and export arms. Prepare one of each and place the chests so the arms reach both their inventory and the platform at once.

Check each block's colour and mode: the input feeds the blank, the output takes the result. The arms are allowed diagonal access, but that does not extend to the drill and the laser. Every part of the system must stay properly linked to the controller.

Load one batch for the chosen program and follow the path from chest to finished piece. Empty platform: look for an import problem; result lying on it: check the export. This kind of diagnosis spares you replacing a sound program when the real mistake is within an arm's reach.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_interf: Two interfaces let you service the chamber without dismantling a wall or losing air. Prepare the pair of blocks, an external feeding inventory and a receiver for the result. When changing the shell, first stop and safely depressurise the system; do not break a wall of a running chamber to fit an input.

Place the interfaces on faces the structure rules allow. The input shows I outward, the output O. Feed the ingredient by hopper or transport and set up extraction of the finished product, keeping extra materials out of the test chest.

Check one recipe and the return of the result without opening the chamber. Every transfer through an interface costs air, so large batches may come out with pauses. Iron is best processed as blocks; there are fewer transfers. That saves transport air, not raises the compression yield itself.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.guide_pressu: The pressure gauge module turns pressure into a control signal, and the safety module adds a separate way to cap the network. Prepare both devices and the expansion card. Stop the compressor before installing and follow the safe procedure for servicing a pneumatic line.

Fit the gauge module onto a tube. The expansion card unlocks the threshold setting: choose a level below the danger zone of the weakest block and tie the signal to the compressor's mode. Configure the safety module by its manual page; the name alone protects nothing.

Run a small fill with no consumer and make sure the supply stops in good time. Do not raise the pressure to destruction to test the safety device. After connecting the chamber the total volume changes, but the limit of the weak tubes stays the same: recheck pressure recovery after one recipe and the control's response.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.0: A printed circuit board goes through several separate stages. Make an empty board in the pressure chamber, then prepare a template for the UV light box. Components that no crafting table can make are ordered through the Amadron tablet: bind a separate payment and delivery chest and check the price before ordering.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.1: Expose the empty board to full exposure, then put it into the etching tank with etching acid. Incomplete exposure leaves a chance of a defect, so master the full cycle first. The tank is handier and safer than an open puddle of acid with items thrown in.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.2: Etching yields an unassembled board that still needs transistors and capacitors. Get four finished boards and do not confuse them with the intermediate ones. Later the assembly line with a laser program will offer another route, but the right electronic components will still be needed.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.title: Printed Circuit Boards
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.plastic.text: PneumaticCraft plastic is born liquid. The refinery separates oil by heating, and the controller needs extra output blocks, usually two to four. One controller from the quest is not yet a working column.

Make LPG and feed it with coal into the thermopneumatic processing plant. By the manual, a hundred units of LPG and one coal give a thousand units of molten plastic; the recipe needs heat but no pressure. Other recipes of the same machine may need both.

Cool the melt in a supported way, for instance by carefully pouring it in a prepared spot, and collect sixteen sheets. Draw off every distillation product: a full tank of heavy fuel will stop the LPG you need as well. Before changing recipe, check the temperature and leftover fluids, and do not mix plastic with fuel tanks.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pressure_ser: Make sixteen compressed iron ingots in the pressure chamber on the safe network you have prepared. Separate ordinary iron from the first explosive batch and clear the input and output interfaces. Before feeding, look up the recipe's minimum pressure in JEI.

Run a small batch and watch the pressure fall during processing and transfers. The interfaces spend air too, so instant compression promises no instant delivery of the whole stack. Let the compressor rebuild the reserve within the safe range.

Gather sixteen finished ingots into your inventory; the goal does not take them, and their origin is unknown to it. For a genuine trial use the chamber's own output, not old items from a chest. The next node will separately check pressure recovery and the compressor cut-off with no consumption.
Manual: run a recipe, observe pressure recovery and verify compressor shutdown without consumption, without approaching destruction.

The pressure test must show two modes: a working consumer and a closed network with no consumption. Prepare one familiar chamber recipe, note the initial reading and make sure the manometer can be read from a safe spot. Do not remove pressurised blocks to watch.

Run the recipe and watch the pressure drop and then recover under the compressor. Then stop consuming air and check that the compressor really switches off at the chosen safe level. There is no need to prove the limiter with the red zone or an explosion.

Both observations made, the goal can be ticked by hand: only what you saw yourself counts here. If pumping continues with no consumption, stop the experiment with the available control and fix the cut-off logic: until it is rechecked, the installation must not be left unattended.

Eight tubes are enough for a small, observable pressure-control section. Take the compressor and chamber you already have, add a manometer and a controlled cut-off. The new tubes are for a clear layout, not for volume: a bigger system takes longer to fill.

Connect the devices, close the unused outputs and make sure nothing hisses. Every early section must stay below the red zone of its gauges. Set the compressor to stop pumping at the chosen safe level even when the machine consumes no air.

The tubes close only the equipment preparation. Before the next batch, check the cut-off on a small fill without driving the pressure to destruction. If the reading dropped after adding tubes, first account for the new total volume: equalising pressure does not always mean a leak.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.0: The ordinary energy cell stores FE locally, the cable carries it between blocks, and the Ender Cell ties the reserve to the owner's wireless channel. Prepare all three and first check the simple chain generator, cell, machine before enabling remote access.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.1: Set the cell's input and output sides, join them with cable and wait for it to charge. Then open the Ender Cell, pick a channel and give it real capacity by adding storage in the supported way. A channel number without capacity becomes no battery.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.2: At the other end of the wireless link, match the owner and the channel. If the remote machine gets no FE, check the channel's reserve and the port limits on both sides. One Ender Cell in your inventory speaks of crafting, not of a working pair and not of the remote area being loaded.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.title: Cells and Cables
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.0: Powah crystals prepare materials for the next tiers of generators and transfer. The Blazing Crystal comes from energising a blaze rod or four blaze powder, the Niotic Crystal from a diamond. Smelting these resources is no substitute for the energizing orb.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.1: Stock up on energy and feed only one required combination at a time. The installed recipes ask a hundred and twenty thousand FE for one Blazing and three hundred thousand for one Niotic. Make four of the first crystal and two of the second and keep them until the goals register.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.2: If processing is slow, check the rods and the energy feed, and do not add a second diamond to an unfinished batch. For continuous work it pays to raise the rods' tier along with generation. A crystal is an ingredient for an improved device; it adds nothing to an old block by lying in a chest nearby.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.title: Crystals
Dielectric paste and casings are the foundation of Powah devices. Gather the ingredients by the current recipe, especially the recurring metals and carbon materials. The paste is a building component, not liquid fuel and no substitute for another mod's insulated cable.

Make eight paste and four casings and let the item goals count both stocks. The next machines will also need capacitors of the right tier; a casing set beside a fire becomes no generator. Look at the first device's recipe before spending the whole batch.

Keep generation and transmission materials apart so something is left to connect the source with after it is built. A small starting stock of paste will serve cables and new components. Scale production up once a working line is chosen: Powah tiers rest on the previous parts and on energised materials.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.dielectric.title: Dielectric
The energizing orb holds the recipe ingredients, while the rods standing nearby feed electricity into the processing. The orb itself needs no FE cable. Place four starter rods close to the orb and connect them to cables or suitable energy blocks.

For energized steel put in one iron ingot and one gold ingot. The installed recipe spends ten thousand FE and yields two ingots; four such operations give the eight the quest wants. Do not load an extra stack of assorted resources if you want to test this exact composition.

Wait for completion and collect the result before a new batch. Speed depends on the number and tier of rods and on the available energy transfer. If the orb does not run, check the full recipe, the distance to the rods and their charge; a big battery next to the orb is no substitute for properly connected rods.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.energizing.title: Energizing Orb
The three starter generators feed differently. The Furnator burns solid fuel, the Magmator consumes lava as a fluid, and the Thermo Generator works above a hot block or fluid and needs coolant, water for instance. A similar name does not let one condition stand in for another.

Test the devices one at a time, connecting each to a single free energy cell. For the thermo generator check the source under the block and the coolant fill, for the magmator the internal lava reserve, for the furnator the fuel. Look at the actual rise in energy.

Choose the main option by what the base can supply steadily. If a generator is full of energy and burns no fuel, first find out whether the network accepts its output. Output depends on tier and settings, so compare the interfaces in FE rather than a figure from another version's guide.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.generators.title: Generators
codex.quest.tech2_powah.guide_orb_batche: Manual: process two separate iron-and-gold batches, removing the output before feeding the next pair.

Automatic feeding into the energizing orb must preserve the composition of a single recipe. Prepare two separate pairs of iron and gold ingots and an empty receiver. Do not start with a chest of every metal: an extra ingredient throws off recipe recognition and stops processing.

Feed the first pair, wait for two energized ingots and take them out. Only when the orb is empty admit the next pair. If transport is doing the work, check its batch limit and the extraction of the result: a constant open flow does not impose that order by itself.

Two operations in a row without mixing inputs, and the manual goal can be ticked. When energy accumulates slowly, do not treat an unfinished batch as free room for new ingots. Later the same sequence applies to crystals, with the filters and quantities changed to match their recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.0: The Powah reactor runs on uraninite and is assembled from thirty-six blocks of one tier. The item goal asks for just one starter block, while a real installation needs the full set. Raw uraninite is first processed into finished fuel by the appropriate recipe.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.1: Clear room for the structure and start placing with the full set in hand: the supported auto-assembly will finish the reactor. Check the interface, the fuel input, the cooling and the extra materials that affect operation, using the guide and the current version's tooltips.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.2: Connect receiving storage and watch fuel consumption and FE output. Do not carry Mekanism's radioactive waste requirements over here: it is a separate system, though it still needs steady supply. Keep eight raw and four finished uraninite until the goals register, and judge operation only after the assembly is complete.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.title: Reactor
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.task.0: Earn the advancement for killing the Ender Dragon
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.0: Dragonslayer records your personal advancement for defeating the Ender Dragon. Find a stronghold, activate its portal with Eyes of Ender, and prepare armour, ranged weapons, blocks and fall protection. Nether access unlocks this card but does not prepare the End portal for you.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.1: On the island, first disable the dragon’s healing by destroying tower crystals from a safe distance. Watch for breath on the ground and avoid platform edges. When the dragon lands, choose a position with an escape route instead of becoming trapped beneath it.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.text.2: After the victory, open the advancements and find your own dragon-kill entry: standing nearby while a friend finishes it off is not enough. There is no need to bring the egg, and the reward is best collected back home, once there is free space in your inventory.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.dragon.title: Dragonslayer
codex.quest.trials_bosses.guide_guard_ro: Check routes from military buildings to two colony entrances and remove obstacles for guards

Garrison size does not guarantee defenders can reach a threat. After hiring eight soldiers, choose two used colony entrances and inspect routes from military buildings. Narrow passages and height changes matter more than extra decorative wall work at this stage.

Walk the routes in the world and observe guards during normal activity. Remove obstacles, provide clear stairs and check doors on approaches. Do not trigger a real raid for testing: accessible working routes and citizens no longer stuck at one point are sufficient.

Once both entrances are checked and the obstacles you found are cleared, tick the manual goal. Come back to this inspection after major rebuilding of roads and warehouses: a new building easily blocks a path that was clear yesterday, and the eight-soldier advancement will not warn you.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.guide_trophy_r: Bring an expedition trophy home, register its advancement and display it safely

A trophy room distinguishes completed journeys from discovered coordinates still awaiting a return visit. Prepare three item frames and choose a protected place at home. Use the native placement method for large or placeable trophies; frames serve smaller items and commemorative materials.

Before displaying an important trophy, ensure it passed through your inventory and registered its advancement. This particularly matters for Eternal Tales banners: direct transfer into remote storage may bypass personal acquisition. Frames may be placed immediately after their quantity registers.

The goal counts as done once at least one expedition trophy has reached home and taken a safe spot. A collection does not belong next to a firing range or open lava. This short pause between journeys also gives you time to count your supplies before the next departure.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.task.0: After the labyrinth stage, complete the Hydra stage through combat or a trophy
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.0: The Hydra belongs to the fiery Twilight Forest region reached after the labyrinth. Its advancement requires labyrinth progress, so bringing a head alone does not guarantee completion. Check local progression, including Meef Stroganoff, before searching for the lair.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.1: Bring fire resistance, food and a weapon you can reliably strike the opening heads with. Keep far enough to see the attacks wind up, and step off burning ground. Tight cover right beside the Hydra takes away your view and your escape instead of protecting you.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.text.2: After the fight, pick up the trophy and check both conditions of the advancement: the labyrinth stage and the confirmed Hydra encounter. The mod accepts several forms of combat progress, and the head stays with you. If the tick is missing, go over the chain first instead of rushing into a rematch.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.hydra.title: Hydra Head
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.task.0: After the Naga stage, complete the Lich stage through combat, a trophy or scepter
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.0: The Lich follows the Naga: the installed advancement requires Naga progress even if you possess a Lich trophy. Check that milestone before climbing the tower, prepare food and clear an escape route through previously visited floors.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.1: Initially, remove the Lich’s shields by reflecting suitable magical projectiles into the real boss. Copies complicate targeting; do not spend all your equipment attacking invulnerable silhouettes. As its protection changes, deal with summoned enemies and the Lich while preserving room to manoeuvre.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.text.2: After the victory, take the trophy or the scepter and check your personal advancement. The installed version accepts several proofs of the fight, but the Naga requirement stays in place. Keep the items: they will serve both your gear and the road ahead through the Twilight Forest.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.lich.title: Lich Dust
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.task.0: Complete the Naga stage through combat, a scale or the trophy
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.0: The Naga is a useful first major encounter in the Twilight Forest and begins its local boss progression. Find a walled Naga courtyard and prepare repaired armour, weapons and food. This card unlocking after Nether access does not remove the dimension’s own restrictions.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.1: Keep room to move around the courtyard and watch the long body’s turns. After landing a hit, avoid blindly chasing the head through obstacles. Collect the dropped scales and trophy, useful both as materials and as evidence of the completed stage.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.text.2: The installed advancement can count combat, Naga scales or the trophy. A trophy received after a shared victory can therefore provide personal progress without another fight. The book keeps your loot intact; check the Naga advancement before travelling to the protected Lich Tower.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.naga.title: Naga Scales
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.task.0: Obtain the Purgatory Banner after defeating Nyetet
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.0: Nyetet, the Fallen Guardian, belongs to Eternal Tales’ Purgatory. This card records obtaining the Purgatory Banner, which the mod uses to confirm that stage. Visiting the dimension and owning suitable equipment alone do not complete the trophy trial.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.1: Leave food and repair supplies at a safe return point before the encounter. Locate the relevant stage of local progression and prepare a position with an escape route that does not drop into unknown terrain. In multiplayer, agree who collects the trophy so it is not lost among other loot.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.text.2: After the victory, take the Purgatory Banner into your own inventory and check the advancement. A banner picked up by a friend will not give you the entry. Once registered, though, you can hang it at home as a keepsake and move on to the next worlds.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.nyetet.title: Fallen Titan
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.task.0: Obtain the Rayana Banner after defeating Pterion
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.0: Pterion is a distinct trophy stage in Eternal Tales’ Rayana. The installed advancement reacts to a Rayana Banner in your inventory, so combat completion does not automatically imply personal registration. Your character must acquire the trophy at least once.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.1: Prepare for an expedition rather than a short duel: bring food, sufficient weapon durability and a safe return method. Locate the encounter through Rayana’s local progression. On unfamiliar terrain, identify edges and passages first; pursuing an enemy should not separate you from the only safe exit.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.text.2: Pick up the Rayana Banner after the victory and check the advancement before sharing the loot with other players. Once registered, you need not carry it around. If the stage does not close, look for where the trophy itself went missing rather than trying to substitute a banner from a neighbouring world.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.pterion.title: Winged Terror
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.task.0: Raise the colony army to eight soldiers
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.0: This card counts a MineColonies garrison of eight soldiers rather than a defeated raid. The corrected name supports peaceful planning: organise colony defence in advance without provoking an attack or waiting for a random event.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.1: Build enough military workplaces, assign citizens to the relevant jobs and provide equipment suitable for their levels. Eight buildings do not equal eight assigned soldiers. Inspect workers through the colony interface and resolve missing food, weapons or access to their posts.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.text.2: Once the army counts eight people, check the military branch advancement. No swords need handing in. After the reward, walk the settlement entrances and the guards' roads: eight soldiers are worth something only if they can reach where they are needed in time.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.raid.title: Eight Soldiers
Obtain the Comet Banner after defeating Terrible Tree

Terrible Tree belongs to an Eternal Tales expedition through Comets. This trial uses an advancement awarded by the installed mod when a Comet Banner enters your inventory. After victory, collect that trophy rather than only nearby materials.

Plan your way back from the Comets, check the durability of your gear and leave a free slot for the banner. The Eternal Tales guide and advancements show how to find the encounter. Not every big tree is a boss, and an ordinary axe will not settle this fight.

After combat, pick up the Comet Banner and let the advancement update before mounting it on a wall. The book does not take the trophy. If the objective remains empty, inspect your personal inventory and advancement: loot sent directly to someone else’s bag or external storage was not acquired by you.
Defeat Unahzaal and earn the Eternal Tales finale advancement
Unahzaal is the final trial of the main Eternal Tales story. The book waits for the separate victory advancement granted by the mod itself; the dimension block on the icon is only a picture, nothing to hand in. A single visit to the Unahzaal Multiverse will not close this goal.

Finish preceding story stages and prepare complete supplies for repair, recovery and combat. Before entering, check where spare equipment is stored and how you return after a failed attempt. Do not begin the final encounter straight after a demanding expedition with nearly broken weapons and no food.

After the victory, wait for the event to end and check your personal Eternal Tales advancement. This is the regular ending; Eternal Darkness with its special conditions belongs to another chapter. Collect the reward once the final scene has safely concluded.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.unahzaal.title: Journey's End
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.task.0: Summon the Wither and earn the Withering Heights advancement
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.0: This card checks summoning the Wither, because that is what the selected Minecraft advancement records. It does not automatically verify victory. Prepare three wither skeleton skulls and four soul sand or soul soil blocks, plus equipment for the subsequent fight.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.1: Choose a site far from your base, animals and important buildings. Build a T-shaped soul-block frame and complete it with three skulls on top. The final skull triggers summoning; retreat immediately because the boss appears through a dangerous charging phase and explosion.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.text.2: The advancement may appear before the fight is over. Do not open the reward while the Wither threatens you or the surroundings, and do not take the tick as a reason to leave him unattended. Finishing the boss and keeping the site intact is your own separate task, and the trophies stay with you.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.wither.title: Summon the Wither
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.task.0: Obtain the Royal Banner after defeating Xaxxas XIX
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.0: Xaxxas XIX concludes an important part of Eternal Tales’ Kingdom of Amber story. The trial checks the advancement through the Royal Banner. It differs from decorative banners of other worlds; this specific stage trophy is required, not any item with a royal-sounding name.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.1: Gather gear and supplies before setting out on the final stretch of the kingdom's chain. Keep to the route through halls you already know and do not leave items needed for progress in some random chest. Follow the kingdom's events and conversations: an open trial card does not cancel the story conditions of the encounter.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.text.2: After the victory, take the Royal Banner into your own inventory and wait for the advancement. Afterwards you can hang it at home. Before moving on, restore your health, repair your gear and count the story loot, so the reward does not distract you from preparing for the next world.
codex.quest.trials_bosses.xaxxas.title: Fall of the King
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.0: Cobblestone accumulates quickly while digging a mine, but this trial needs a prepared reserve: 192 ordinary blocks, or three full stacks. Cobbled deepslate, smooth stone and decorative variants are excluded.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.1: Choose a safe patch of ordinary stone and mine it with a pickaxe without Silk Touch. Light the work area, close dangerous passages and reserve materials for furnaces and stair repairs first. Digging straight down for the final stack introduces needless risk.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.2: All three stacks must be in your inventory together when submitted and will be consumed. If the count looks wrong, check block names rather than their grey texture. The remaining excavation can become an access passage to a future mining site.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.title: Stonecutter
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.0: This pantry accepts 32 portions of cooked beef. Chicken, raw meat and elaborate dishes feed you well, but they do not count toward this delivery. Gather the batch separately from the food you take into the mine or on an expedition.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.1: For a renewable source, keep cows, breed adults with wheat and preserve a breeding pair. Cook surplus raw beef in a furnace or smoker. Check fuel before loading everything: an underfuelled furnace often explains missing portions.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.2: All 32 servings must be in your inventory together at submission, and the book consumes them. This exchanges supplies rather than feeding particular colony citizens. Afterwards, the retained herd produces both more meat and leather for the neighbouring trial.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.title: Pantry
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.0: The glass delivery closes the early chain with a material useful for tanks and windows. It needs 64 ordinary glass blocks; panes, stained glass and tinted glass have different item identities and do not count.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.1: Gather sand without undermining your house or paths, then put it in a fuelled furnace. Splitting the work across furnaces reduces waiting but does not change the total material cost. Reserve some future glass for your own technical recipes.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.2: Collect a sufficient batch into your inventory and submit it together: the book removes 64 blocks. Do not place delivery glass as temporary storage, because recovering it requires a suitable tool. After the exchange, you have a straightforward bulk-smelting process for the next production order.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.title: Glassblower
Charcoal feeds your first furnaces while a new coal seam is still to be found. This side delivery accepts sixteen pieces of charcoal specifically. Coal burns the same way, but to the book it is a different item.

Grow trees in your plantation, reserve building wood and smelt surplus logs in a furnace. The first run needs separate fuel; afterwards, some charcoal can return to the fuel slot. Do not turn logs into planks before smelting, as that changes the input material.

Select 16 pieces and bring them together in your inventory: the book consumes them upon submission. Keep the remaining charcoal for the next cycle. Fuel self-sufficiency depends on actually reserving fuel rather than submitting the final portion along with the entire output.
codex.quest.trials_early.guide_iron_rese: A successful delivery should not leave you without mining tools or protection. Prepare a bucket, shield and iron pickaxe after the early exchange. These items serve different everyday needs: handling water, combat defence and mining resources accessible to iron tools.

Craft missing pieces from reserved ingots and let the book see each item first. Different objectives can be shown sequentially; an existing serviceable pickaxe replaces crafting another. The bucket must be empty for registration: a water bucket has a different item identity.

There is no turn-in or equipment loss here. After registration, fill the bucket with water, place the shield in a convenient slot and resume ordinary work. This reserve matters when a tempting new order would otherwise use the final ingots and leave no repair stock.
codex.quest.trials_early.guide_replant.t: Plant oaks and wait for at least one tree to grow

After delivering logs, check that you still have a forest for the next order. Collect eight oak saplings from decaying leaves and prepare a lit patch of dirt. This is a small renewable plantation, not a demand to clear another natural forest.

Hold all eight saplings together in your inventory, then plant them: registered items may be used without preparing another batch. Leave clear space above and avoid low roofs. The first grown oak confirms that the site actually supports growth.

Tick the manual goal once the first tree has risen on your plot: it alone proves there is enough light and room. After felling, keep a few new saplings, and your timber deliveries will no longer depend on how far away the untouched forest has drifted.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.reward.0: One and a half ingots per ingot turned in — ore doubling before Create
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.0: The iron delivery comes after you have made your own tools, not instead of them. Prepare 32 iron ingots: raw iron and iron blocks will not count until you smelt or unpack them into ingots.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.1: Mine ore with a suitable pickaxe and smelt raw iron with enough fuel. Reserve ingots for a bucket, shield and tool repairs first. Do not assume undocumented reward enchantments: the book shows the actual reward contents before you confirm the exchange.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.2: Take the whole batch out of the furnace and put it in your inventory. The 32 ingots vanish on hand-in, so do not give away iron already promised to an urgent build. The trial unlocks the food delivery, and the metal you set aside lets you keep developing the base without a pause.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.title: First Iron
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.0: Leather goes into books and part of your travelling gear, so give away only what is left after your own needs. The trial accepts 16 pieces of plain leather; finished leather armour and hides from other creatures are different items.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.1: Use the herd prepared for the meat delivery: raise calves and obtain leather from adult cows while keeping breeding animals. Drops do not arrive in identical amounts, so plan from chest contents rather than the number of animals already killed.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.2: Move the sixteen pieces into your inventory right before handing in: they are gone for good. If you plan to enchant tools, keep some back for books. This way the trial closes without losing the herd, and the materials for furnishing your home stay with you.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.title: Tanner
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.0: The first delivery turns ordinary logging into supplies for the next stage. It requires exactly 64 oak logs: planks, stripped wood and other species do not replace this item, even when they work in most building recipes.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.1: Find oak trees near your base, bring an axe and reserve some saplings for replanting. Keep the delivery separate from wood needed for a crafting table, chests and charcoal. Remove remaining trunk blocks so leaves can clear space for new trees.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.2: Move the full stack of logs into your inventory before submitting. The book consumes all 64; briefly owning them earlier does not count here. Plant the reserved saplings now so the next building project does not send you farther from home.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.title: Woodcutter
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.0: Atomic alloy completes Mekanism’s alloy-upgrade sequence and supports advanced equipment. This trial accepts 16 finished atomic alloys. Infused and reinforced alloys are earlier stages, so owning them alone does not satisfy the final objective.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.1: Follow the recipe from infused alloy through diamond infusion into reinforced alloy, then apply refined obsidian infusion for atomic alloy. Preparing the infusion material also requires resources and machinery. Inspect the infuser before loading expensive components: another infusion type does not mix with the required one.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.text.2: Set aside sixteen completed alloys and submit them together from your inventory; the whole batch is lost in exchange for the reward. Reserve some for your own pipes, machines and circuits. The following pellet trial needs separate nuclear infrastructure that atomic alloys alone cannot replace.
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.title: Atomic Alloy
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.0: The archive delivery accepts four 64k storage parts, not disks holding your network's contents. A part is the blank for a disk; it stores nothing on its own. That way the order tests your memory output while the working storage stays untouched: no need to move thousands of items.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.1: Combine smaller-capacity parts into four 64k components using Refined Storage recipes. One component plus a housing produces one disk of that capacity. Do not remove filled disks from a drive for this objective or assume the book checks whether they are empty before consuming them.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.text.2: All four parts must be in your inventory at the same time; they vanish on hand-in. The reward returns eight such parts, and with housings they make eight disks, not two. Before expanding the network, check its power and look at the grid: what sits where, and whether there is room.
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.title: Archivist
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.0: The polymer delivery combines two Immersive Engineering chemical products: 32 duroplast plates and four biodiesel buckets. Simple wood smelting does not produce these materials. Working chemical multiblocks and separate intermediate-fluid containers are required.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.1: Plates are cast in a bottling machine using phenolic resin and a plate mold; each costs 250 mB and returns the mold. Biodiesel is made in a refinery from plant oil and ethanol with saltpeter as catalyst. Check power and free fluid output space throughout the chain.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.2: Move the finished plates and four full buckets into your inventory at the same time. The hand-in takes both batches together with the buckets themselves: do not expect the empty containers back. Keep a reserve of resin and fuel at the base, or the chemical line will stop right after the reward.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.title: Polymers
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.0: Electrum is used in electrical components from Create Crafts & Additions. This trial requests 32 ingots and 64 wires specifically from that addon. Similar ingots from other mods may work in recipes, but delivery objectives distinguish exact items.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.1: Alloy gold with silver by the add-on's recipe, then roll part of the ingots into wire on the rolling mill. Do not send all the metal through the mill: the hand-in needs ingots too. JEI shows how much wire one ingot yields; work out the raw materials before starting the run.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.2: Put both batches in your inventory at once: the book takes the 32 ingots and the 64 wires. Cable already strung between machines does not qualify. Keep intermediates in separate crates, and your working parts will not leave with the delivery while production of the costlier alloys carries on.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.title: Conductor
codex.quest.trials_late.guide_archive_re: Add a new empty disk, then insert and retrieve a test batch of 64 cobblestone through the grid

New capacity helps only when the network actually accepts and returns items. After the archive delivery, craft one new disk from a rewarded component and a housing. Test with a cheap batch of 64 cobblestone rather than working tools or rare trophies.

Insert the empty disk into a connected disk drive, make sure the controller is powered and the capacity has grown. Put the test stack in through the grid, find it with the search and pull it back out. Leave the full disks where they are: removing them would change the experiment and cut you off from your own belongings.

Tick the manual goal once all 64 blocks have come back to you. If the grid does not respond, restore power and the connection instead of shuffling full drives around. This short experiment separates real storage growth from a handsome new disk that merely occupies a slot.
codex.quest.trials_late.guide_waste_stop: At a minimal safe operating rate, manually stop the reactor and verify burning stops while cooling and waste handling remain available

Pellets in a chest do not show whether you can stop their source. This optional check concerns an already sound Mekanism fission reactor. Do not start a damaged reactor for a checkmark or deliberately cause radioactive-waste overflow as a test.

At a minimal safe operating rate, use the reactor’s normal shutdown and observe fuel burning stop. Cooling and the waste route must remain available after shutdown because residual heat does not vanish instantly. Compare container levels before and after without dismantling occupied radioactive blocks.

Confirm the goal once burning has stopped on command while cooling and waste removal still cope. If the temperature climbs or the output is blocked, find the cause and keep the reactor off. Work only in a full protective suit with a dosimeter at hand; the reward does not excuse you from watching over the installation.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.0: Aeronautics levitite is the material of an airship's lifting parts. Set aside 64 units of plain levitite here, not the pearlescent kind. The delivery concerns only the stock of material; whether the assembled ship can lift its own weight, only a test flight will tell.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.1: First inspect the available recipe and acquisition methods for ordinary levitite in this installed pack. Prepare a separate raw-material batch without removing lifting elements from an operating vessel. Keep flight-test materials on the ground: modifying a structure in flight can disturb its balance and lift.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.text.2: The entire stack must be in your inventory during submission, after which the book consumes it. If the objective shows less than expected, check the material variant and exclude already installed blocks. Fit rewarded aviation components to a moored structure, then recheck controllability.
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.title: Lighter Than Air
codex.quest.trials_late.nethersteel.text: Big Cannons nethersteel is a specialised cannon alloy, not ordinary Minecraft netherite. The exchange requires 16 ingots. Reserve metal for planned breeches and other parts first: this delivery does not verify a completed gun.

The installed mixing recipe combines netherite scrap with steel or cast iron under a superheated burner. Ordinary heat is insufficient. Check the chosen variant in JEI: the recipes require different amounts of base metal, so swapping steel for cast iron without recalculating breaks the basin load.

After a successful test batch, collect sixteen ingots in your inventory and submit them together; they are consumed. Molten metal in a tank and nuggets are different forms. For later cannon construction, separately check casting, boring and material compatibility requirements.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.0: Eight polonium and eight plutonium pellets are the fruit of Mekanism's nuclear waste processing. Pellets in a chest say nothing about whether your reactor is safe. Take on the delivery only once the cooling holds, the waste flows out, and the emergency shutdown has been tested.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.1: Waste branches into a solar neutron activator for polonium and isotopic centrifuging for plutonium; later reaction-chamber processing produces pellets according to the recipes. Do not dismantle radioactive pipes or containers while occupied: radiation may be released. Use complete protective equipment and monitor exposure during this work.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.2: Set aside the completed pellets: all sixteen are required together at submission and are consumed. Correct missing sunlight or reagents at the affected stage instead of blindly increasing reactor output. The reward cannot compensate for overheating or contamination of your base.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.title: Nuclear Cycle
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.0: Sturdy sheets are needed where ordinary Create rolling no longer holds up. The delivery requires 64 finished sheets; obsidian dust and half-made blanks do not count. Arrange a steady lava supply and a place for the cooled finished product to go.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.1: Sequenced assembly starts with obsidian dust: a spout supplies 500 mB of lava, followed by two pressing operations. This is one processing sequence, so the first press stroke does not finish the job. Send a single blank through the entire route and check its final name first.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.text.2: Only then run a stack. All 64 sturdy sheets must be in your inventory at submission and will be consumed. If intermediate items clog the output, repair the second-pressing route; extra lava does not replace a missing mechanical operation.
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.title: Heavy Industry
codex.quest.trials_late.truadamantite.te: Eternal Tales truadamantite is a composite late-game material, not an ore you can dig up in a single dimension. The delivery needs 16 ingots. Before giving away the rare metal, set a share aside for your own gear: the reward is not obliged to match what your character lacks right now.

The installed ingot recipe combines brimstone fungi, tungsten, netherite, venetium, adamantite and two phantom membranes. Check each ingredient’s availability separately; access to the Kingdom of Amber does not create these resources automatically. Craft one ingot first and verify the resulting item.

Accumulate sixteen ingots together in your inventory: submission consumes the entire batch. Unpack blocks or combine nuggets into ingots using their corresponding recipes beforehand. Finishing this chain demonstrates sustained collection of varied resources rather than one lucky rare chest.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.0: Andesite alloy becomes a consumable for much of early Create engineering. Prepare 128 pieces for this trial while reserving some for shafts and casings. A working mixer is convenient, but the book accepts finished output regardless of the recipe used.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.1: The recipe is simple: andesite and metal nuggets, and the mixer turns it into mass production. Check JEI, run a small trial batch, and only then load the full stock. The mixer needs more than a basin beneath it: it needs rotation with enough force.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.2: The exchange consumes two full stacks together from your inventory. If factory construction stops afterwards, operating reserves were submitted with the surplus. Separating stocks lets you move on to iron and copper pressing without that interruption.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.title: Andesite River
