codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.0: Brass moves Create towards controlled logistics and precision assembly. This delivery requires 64 brass ingots, surplus after providing your first brass components. The ingots alone do not automatically verify heating or mixer operation.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.1: Mix copper and zinc in a basin beneath a mechanical mixer with heat from a fuelled burner. First confirm that the burner is actually heating and the mixer rotates fast enough. Metals left in the basin mean processing has not finished, even when the machinery is moving.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.2: Gather all 64 ingots in your inventory before submitting; the whole batch is consumed. Do not convert delivery ingots into casings beforehand. Precision mechanisms are a useful next project because their production uses the capabilities of the brass machinery you have just learned.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.title: Brass Standard
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.0: The bread tribute accepts 128 ordinary Minecraft loaves. This is food exchanged for a reward, not automatic MineColonies feeding: the book removes inventory items and does not distribute them to restaurants or the colony warehouse.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.1: Bake bread from wheat on a crafting table, or leave it to a food line you have already set up in Create or in the colony. First set aside seeds for resowing and leave the citizens' current rations alone. If you count on the baker, look at his real requests and output: two stacks may take longer to gather than you expect.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.2: Collect both stacks of 64 in your inventory before confirming, as the entire batch is consumed together. A separate delivery chest prevents taking the final loaves from the shared kitchen. Check grain reserves afterwards: a sustainable food supply matters more than a one-off production record.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.title: Bread Tribute
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.0: Eight advanced control circuits require learning Mekanism’s basic electronic upgrades. They are used in higher-tier machines, so reserve components for your own installations first. The trial counts completed circuits, not alloys or unfinished recipe ingredients.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.1: Craft basic control circuits and upgrade them with infused alloys using the recipe shown in JEI. An infuser processing different materials must contain the appropriate infusion type: leftover incompatible material prevents the next process. Separate machines or a planned queue avoid unnecessary clearing.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.2: Gather eight advanced circuits in your inventory and submit them together; they are consumed. Rewards may save assembly work on later components, but do not verify mastery of the entire chemical chain. Before expanding, ensure your normal raw-material supply can reproduce these eight circuits.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.title: Circuitry
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.reward.0: A second coke oven lasts the whole game
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.0: The coke oven produces solid fuel and creosote, so this trial requests both outputs: 128 coal coke and eight creosote buckets. Fluid removal matters for continuous operation; a full internal tank can stop production before coal runs out.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.1: Process coal in an assembled coke oven, collect coke and regularly drain the fluid output into suitable containers or storage. The objective specifically needs filled bucket items. Reserve fuel for your blast furnace separately, or the exchange will interrupt the neighbouring steel order.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.2: Before submitting, hold both coke stacks and eight filled buckets together in your inventory. The book consumes the coke and the bucket items themselves; empty containers are not promised back. Clear enough slots beforehand rather than fetching the final part during the exchange.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.title: Coke Chemistry
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_output_buff: Process one brass batch with automatic chest collection and no drops on the ground

Bulk brass production becomes awkward when output scatters on the floor or remains in an overfilled basin. Prepare two chests, one for input and one for output. Owning them helps organise the area, but only a test run verifies actual transport.

Connect available hoppers or Create transport so finished output reaches its chest. Raw materials and completed ingots should not endlessly return to the same feed. Once the book registers the chests in inventory, place them immediately; no extra copies are needed for the objective.

Run one small batch and follow the complete output route. Confirm the manual check once ingots reach the chest without picking them up from the floor. If output stalls, first check space and funnel direction, then investigate the mixing process itself.
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_resume.task: Let input run out, replenish it and obtain more brass without rebuilding the line
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_resume.text: A production line is convenient when ordinary material shortages do not require dismantling it. Perform a small stop-and-resume experiment on the brass installation you have already tested. Use a small load to avoid wasting rare inputs or draining the main factory reserve.

Wait for one input material to run out and observe where processing stops. Replenish that material through the normal inlet while preserving power, heat and transport direction. Do not remove remaining basin items without reason; they may correctly belong to the next recipe.

Confirm once a new brass batch reaches the output chest by itself without rebuilding the installation. If an intermediate item needed manual rescue, fix the cause and repeat. This diagnosis matters more than extra speed while the chain cannot yet recover from ordinary shortages.
codex.quest.trials_mid.guide_seed_reserv: Harvest a wheat plot and fully replant it while retaining food for citizens

A large bread delivery succeeds when the next harvest remains possible afterwards. Prepare thirty-two wheat seeds and inspect the field that actually feeds your kitchen. Store planting stock separately from supplies exposed to accidental processing or animal feeding.

Show the entire seed reserve together in your inventory, then use it to replant after harvesting mature wheat. Confirm that farmland retains suitable growing conditions and remains accessible. In a colony, inspect farmer requests and tools instead of assuming the building operates on its own.

Complete the manual objective after fully replanting the chosen plot while keeping food for citizens. Seeds are not submitted and may already be in the ground when you confirm. The next harvest should grow your reserve rather than repair food production accidentally destroyed by a delivery.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.0: Osmium and steel support Mekanism casings and further machines. The delivery combines 64 osmium ingots and 32 steel ingots from that mod. Despite the familiar steel name, Immersive Engineering output does not automatically replace the required item.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.1: Obtain osmium from mined material through available smelting or processing. For steel, use a metallurgic infuser: carbon treatment turns iron into enriched iron and then steel dust, which must be smelted. Monitor carbon supply and machine power at each step.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.2: All osmium and steel must be in your inventory together at submission; the book consumes both batches. Keep casing materials if you intend to continue into circuitry immediately. This delivery is most useful once mining and carbon processing can replenish the surplus you set aside.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.title: Osmium Reserve
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.0: Sixteen precision mechanisms test finished output rather than the number of incomplete assemblies. These components control more advanced Create machinery. Allow extra raw materials because sequenced assembly can finish with a by-product instead of the desired mechanism.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.1: It all starts from a gold sheet. Deployers add a small cogwheel, a large cogwheel and an iron nugget in turn, and the whole sequence repeats five times. Mechanical crafters play no part here. Before feeding a large batch, arrange for unfinished parts to loop back and for the finished result to leave through its own output.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.2: Select 16 completed mechanisms and hold them together in your inventory. Submission removes them; incomplete mechanisms cannot make up a shortfall. If production stalls, inspect every deployer’s consumables and the return route rather than increasing speed blindly.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.title: Precision Work
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.0: The Refined Storage improved processor belongs to storage-network electronics, not Mekanism control circuits. This trial needs 16 completed improved processors. Provide your own controller and storage access first so the exchange does not consume materials needed for an urgent expansion.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.1: Open the improved processor recipe and follow the route from unfinished assembly to completed component. Prepare silicon, binding material and the required metals; a raw processor still needs processing according to its recipe. Check the final item name before automatically sending the entire batch to a chest.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.text.2: All sixteen processors must be in your inventory when submitted and will be removed. You do not need to dismantle disks or withdraw the contents of active storage. Steady processor production later supports memory components when mining output exceeds your first chests.
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.title: Silicon Valley
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.0: The pressing trial combines two metals: 64 iron sheets and 32 copper sheets from Create. The batch shows that your press handles different orders, although the book cannot tell whether items arrived on a belt or by hand.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.1: Place the press above a depot or working belt segment, supply rotation and process one ingot of each metal first. Run separate batches after checking the result, making leftover ingots and output chests easier to distinguish. Check the item names of plates from other mods.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.2: Both batches must be present together now; you cannot submit iron and bring copper later. The book consumes all 96 sheets. Keep some for your own casings and transport so the brass order does not stall because its supporting infrastructure was sacrificed.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.title: Rolled Stock
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.0: The steel delivery reinforces operation of an Immersive Engineering blast furnace. It accepts 64 steel ingots specifically from that mod. Recipe compatibility between steels does not make them the same item to the book; inspect the output’s mod label.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.1: Supply iron and suitable blast-furnace fuel, then clear the steel and slag outputs. An ordinary furnace does not turn iron ingots into steel. Watch one full cycle before committing a large batch, confirming that fuel sustains processing and previous materials have not blocked the output.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.2: Move a full stack of finished steel into your inventory: submission consumes all 64 ingots. Keep your own construction reserve, particularly if electrical infrastructure is next. The coke trial then examines the fuel supply supporting this smelting process.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.title: Steelmaker
codex.settings.cover.desc: Show the cover with the short guide, or go straight to the map.
codex.settings.intro: The progression order is stored in your server-side progress and applies only to you. The other settings belong to this client.
codex.settings.order.free.desc: Every quest is available at once and finished work counts immediately. Links between quests are navigation only.
codex.settings.order.map.desc: Only earlier steps of the same map are required. Links to other maps remain hints and never block a quest.
codex.settings.order.strict.desc: A quest unlocks after all its prerequisites, including quests on other maps. This is how GTNH progression works.
codex.settings.title: CODEX SETTINGS
codex.settings.toasts.desc: A pop-up in the corner of the screen when a quest is completed.
codex.settings.tooltips.desc: Hovering an objective or reward item shows its name, mod and description.
codex.title: Codex
codex.ui.claim_consume: Turn in items and claim reward
codex.ui.inventory_rules: Ordinary item goals remember the largest inventory quantity seen for each item. Different items can be shown separately; recorded machinery need not be dismantled. For counts above one, gather the required quantity of that item together. Turn-in goals require all listed supplies at claim time and consume them.
codex.ui.jei_hint: Left-click an item for its recipe, right-click for its uses.
codex.ui.legend: Green: done · Gold: available · Dashed: any path · ◇: optional
codex.ui.local_notice: Without the mod on the server, items are neither given nor taken.
codex.ui.navigation: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom at the cursor; Home fits the map. Right-click pins a quest. Search: Enter or F3 jumps to the next match. Quest links lead to prerequisites and next steps.
codex.ui.tip.claim: A reward is waiting — open the quest
codex.welcome.eyebrow: A FIELD GUIDE TO YOUR WORLD
codex.welcome.promise: Choose a branch that interests you. Each quest explains preparation, actions and results. Connections show which knowledge and tools you will need next.
codex.welcome.purpose: Every great discovery begins with a first step. The Codex guides you from your first workshop to complex production lines, distant expeditions and magic, even if these mods are entirely new to you.
codex.welcome.step1.body: Choose a map and open a node. Solid links require previous steps; dashed links offer alternatives. Diamonds mark optional branches. Search finds quest titles or item identifiers.
codex.welcome.step1.title: Find your path
codex.welcome.step2.body: Read the explanation and complete its objectives. Items and advancements are tracked automatically. Tick manual goals after checking the result. Turn-in buttons consume the listed resources and give rewards.
codex.welcome.step2.title: Put knowledge to work
codex.welcome.step3.body: Drag the map, zoom with the wheel and press Home for an overview. Right-click pins a quest. Click an item for JEI recipes; follow links to related steps. The book key and Esc close the screen.
codex.welcome.step3.title: Keep your bearings
codex.welcome.title: Codex Aethernum
